k: It is used to automate processes .
It reduces human errors .
It improves efficiency .
Always link each point to the scenario in the question.

items.t: Five components of an information system
items.tz: 资讯系统的五个组成部分
k: The five components are data, hardware, software, process and personnel .
If one is missing, the system cannot work properly .
Data is stored in storage devices and used by programs for input/output .
Forms: text, image, audio, video .
Hardware refers to the physical devices used in an information system .
State the device and its function, e.g. "barcode scanner – input".

items.tz: 软件：系统软件与应用软件
k: Software refers to the programs running in an information system .
System software runs and maintains the computer; application software lets users do specific tasks .
Process determines the order in which data is processed .
It ensures data achieves the purpose precisely .
Match each role to its duty using the bold phrases.
Data is unorganised facts with no meaning on its own .
Information is processed data put into context , useful for decision making .
Name each stage concretely: what data, which device / what calculation / what result and form .
Text is represented by a character encoding system .
Sender and receiver must use the same encoding , or text shows as garbled characters.
Plain text stores characters only.
Formatted text stores characters and their formatting data ; its file size is larger .
Bitmap images are stored as pixels , each with a binary number for its colour.
Vector images are stored as mathematical formulae ; they do not become blurry when scaled .
Digital audio is data that can be converted to sounds (analog signals) .
Stored digitally so it can be edited and reproduced .
Videos are combinations of images and audios.
Usually stored as compressed files because of their large size.
Information processing converts raw data into meaningful information.
Stages: data collection, organisation, storage, processing, analysis, transmission, presentation .

items.t: Data collection: methods, scope, data type
items.tz: 数据收集：方法、范围、数据类型
k: Consider the scope and the data type when choosing a collection method.
Input devices enhance efficiency and precision .
Organisation means managing, categorising and classifying data to facilitate processing .
Three ways: arrangement, validation, type conversion .
Data is stored so that it can be retrieved and processed anytime .
Choose by capacity, portability, access .
Processing means editing, modifying and updating data .
Analysis extracts meaningful information from processed data (e.g. identify trends, make predictions ).
Transmitters, media and receivers ; both sides use the same protocol .
Presentation is the output of data or information through various media .
In the Information Age, accessing and publishing information have become easier and more popular .

items.t: Causes: personal computers and mobile devices
items.tz: 成因：个人电脑与流动装置
k: Three causes: price, performance, application design .
Optical fibres and telecom advances enhanced the mobility and coverage of information .
IoT is the network of physical objects ; data is exchanged among devices .

items.t: Development: big data and artificial intelligence
items.tz: 发展：大数据与人工智能
k: Big data: vast amount of data gathered → valuable information after analysis.
AI processes and analyses large amounts of data in a short time ; with deep learning it can learn by itself .
Four aspects: intellectual property, data privacy, credibility, extraction and organisation .

mc.q: A bus company provides an online service for passengers to find bus routes. What information should passengers input?
mc.e: To find a route the system only needs where you start and where you go; stops and fare are outputs.

mc.q: When editing a document, which of the following word processing features can enhance its readability?
mc.e: Tables and footnotes change how the reader sees the content; find and replace is an editing tool.

mc.q:
Tom wants to store some weather information obtained from the Hong Kong Observatory. A sample of the weather information is shown below.
Temperature: 25.8
UV index: 4
Air pollution: moderate
Which of the following sets of data types is most appropriate?
o: Temperature: String, UV index: Character, Air pollution: String
Temperature: Integer, UV index: Character, Air pollution: Boolean
Temperature: Real, UV index: Integer, Air pollution: String
Temperature: Real, UV index: String, Air pollution: Boolean
mc.e: 25.8 is real, 4 is integer, 'moderate' is text (string).

mc.q: A public library is going to digitise a collection of valuable antique books. What is the major benefit of digitisation?
o: The library can destroy the books to save storage space.
More people can easily access the books.
It improves the protection of intellectual property.
mc.e: Digital copies can be read by many people at once without touching the fragile originals.

mc.q: In data processing, a clerk in a school types in the examination marks of students from a mark sheet into a computer system. Then he prints out the marks. What should he do next?
o: Find the student with the highest mark.
Check the printout against the mark sheet.
mc.e: Proofreading the printout against the source document is verification of input.

mc.q: Which of the following features in presentation software can control the transition of slides?
mc.e: Action buttons and hyperlinks can jump to other slides; layout only arranges content.

mc.q:
Ms Wong works in a publishing company and has to create the following three documents.
For which document(s) should she adopt the PDF format instead of the DOC format?
mc.e: Receipts and e-books should not be edited and must look the same everywhere; a template needs to be editable (DOC).

mc.q: John uses his notebook computer to create a web-based presentation through a web site. He does not use the pre-installed presentation software to do so. Why?
st: (1) He can add more slides in the presentation.
(2) He can edit the presentation in other computers without presentation software.
(3) He can add video clips in the presentation.
mc.e: A web-based tool only needs a browser, so he can edit anywhere; slides and videos are possible in both.

mc.q:
In a law firm, the lawyers need to read many archive documents every day. The firm plans to scan and store its archive documents as digital images so that the lawyers can use computers to search and view the documents.

What is the major benefit of such digitisation?
o: The intellectual property of the documents can be well protected.
The lawyers can easily make copies of the documents.
The lawyers can save time typing documents.
The lawyers can easily retrieve and read a document.
mc.e: The stated aim is to search and view documents on computers, so retrieval is easier.

mc.q: When inserting a hyperlink in a slide in a presentation file, which of the following can be linked?
mc.e: A hyperlink can point to any file or URL.

mc.q:
On a web page, some data are entered using a drop-down list instead of a text box, as shown below. What are the major benefits of this design?

[ Hong Kong Museum of Art (10 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon) ▼ ]
mc.e: Choosing from a list is faster and avoids typing errors; it does not allow more words.

mc.q:
Mary uses presentation software to create a self-running slide show with verbal commentary. She uploads the slide show to her web site so that the public can view it.

Which of the following must Mary do when creating the slide show?
o: Set the timing of each slide.
Create animation effects in the slides.
Insert background music in the slides.
mc.e: A self-running show needs slide timings so it advances on its own.

mc.q: Which of the following statements about mail merge is correct?
o: Only one file is needed in each mail merge.
Mail merge is mainly used for sending email.
Data can be sorted and filtered for a mail merge.
Mail merge usually involves presentation software.
mc.e: Mail merge combines a main document with a data source whose records can be sorted and filtered.

mc.q: Eva creates a report with 200 pages. Which of the following word processing operations can reduce the number of pages used?
st: (1) Change the line spacing of the text.
(4) Create a table of contents with hyperlinks.
mc.e: Smaller line spacing and margins fit more text per page.

mc.q: Radio frequency identification (RFID) readers are installed in the door of an office. Amy has an ID badge containing a RFID tag with a 2 KB storage capacity. Her personal information occupies 200 bytes. Every time she enters or leaves the office, a record of 40 bytes is created and stored on her badge. How many records can the badge store?
Which of the following is the least important when creating a self-running presentation?
mc.e: A self-running show plays in order, so an index for navigation is least needed.

mc.q: Which of the following can effectively format a document in word processing software?
st: Setting the default font as the most frequently-used font type and font size
mc.e: Default font and pre-set styles both control formatting. Auto-correction fixes spelling/typing, not format.

mc.q: Mary is a marketing manager and plans to send invitation letters to selected customers. She will extract data from a customer database. What information processes should she do?
mc.e: Filter to select customers, then mail merge to make letters. What-if analysis is for spreadsheet modelling.

mc.q: Which of the following is correct?
o: Information process: Data collection, Example: Creating a statistical chart
Information process: Data preparation, Example: Validating questionnaires before input
Information process: Data processing, Example: Sorting questionnaires for data entry
Information process: Data organisation, Example: Designing an online questionnaire
mc.e: Checking questionnaires before input is data preparation. Charts are presentation, designing a form is collection.

mc.q: Which of the following about a presentation of several slides supplemented with verbal annotation in presentation software is correct?
o: The presentation should be in a video file format such as MP4.
Verbal annotation can be recorded for slides individually.
The duration of each slide for verbal annotation is the same.
mc.e: Narration is recorded slide by slide, and each slide can last a different time.

mc.q: Which of the following should be considered when creating a presentation for a project using presentation software?
mc.e: Layout, colours and slide order all affect a presentation.

mc.q: Which of the following may involve Object Linking and Embedding (OLE)?
st: Using mail merge to create documents
Inserting images in a presentation slide
mc.e: Mail merge links to an outside data file and inserted images can be embedded or linked. A pivot table works inside one spreadsheet.

mc.q: Which of the following attributes of an object will be saved when using Object Linking and Embedding with a document?
o: Object Linking: Path of the object, Object Embedding: Path of the object
Object Linking: Object content, Object Embedding: Path of the object
Object Linking: Path of the object, Object Embedding: Object content
Object Linking: Object content, Object Embedding: Object content
mc.e: Linking stores only a reference (path) to the source; embedding stores a copy of the content.

mc.q: In an information system, which match is incorrect?
o: Data: information of students in a school
mc.e: A word processor is software, not personnel.
mc.ez: 文书处理软件是软件，不是人员。

mc.q: Which is/are example(s) of data? (1) student names (2) prices of goods (3) utility software
mc.e: Utility software is software, not data.

mc.q: Which set of hardware function and hardware is correct?
mc.e: A switch is for network communication.

mc.q: Which is/are system software? (1) Android (2) Anti-malware (3) Google Chrome
mc.e: Android is an OS, anti-malware is a utility; Chrome is application software.

mc.q: Which personnel is responsible for integrating hardware, software and network in developing a mobile phone application?
mc.e: Computer engineers design, build and integrate hardware, software and network.

mc.q: Which statement about text is correct?
o: Formatted text usually has a larger file size than plain text.
Plain text usually has a larger file size than formatted text.
Plain text stores font type and font size.
Formatted text usually does not support font colour.
mc.e: Formatted text also stores formatting data.
mc.ez: 格式化文本还储存格式资料。

mc.q: Which statement about images is correct?
o: Bitmap images are stored as mathematical formulae.
Digital images are usually bitmap images.
Vector images are stored as a series of pixels.
Digital images are usually vector images.
mc.e: Photos from digital cameras are bitmaps.

mc.q: Which is/are analog signals? (1) Electricity (from a microphone) (2) Music played from a speaker (3) MIDI file
mc.e: A MIDI file is digital data.

mc.q: Which statement about videos is correct?
o: Videos usually have a smaller file size than images.
Videos are combinations of images and audio.
Videos can be edited with any photo editing software.
Videos are usually compressed for higher quality.
mc.e: By definition; compression reduces size, not raises quality.
mc.ez: 影片是图像和音频的组合。

mc.q: Which is/are data collection methods? (1) Interviews (2) Experiments (3) Surveys
mc.e: All three are listed collection methods.

mc.q: Which action considering data privacy is correct?
o: Sharing friends' private information without asking beforehand.
Choosing important personal information to share on social media.
Asking permission before sharing a friend's private information on social media.
Sharing credit card information to unauthenticated websites.
mc.e: Ask for permission first.

mc.q: Diana has over 200 footages. Which help her search them more efficiently? (1) Subtitling the footages (2) Stating the creation date in filenames (3) Putting footages filmed in the same week into one folder
mc.e: Subtitles don't make searching easier.

mc.q: The main purposes of implementing an information system include all EXCEPT
o: removing the need for any data
mc.e: Information systems process data; they don't remove it.

mc.q: A library updates the status of a book whenever it is borrowed. This mainly shows that an information system can
o: keep records up to date automatically
mc.e: Status is updated in the system automatically.

mc.q: Which is NOT a component of an information system in the textbook?
mc.e: Components: data, hardware, software, process, personnel.

mc.q: A motherboard is mainly used for
mc.e: Table 1.1.

mc.q: Which of the following is an input device?
mc.e: Barcode scanners read data in.

mc.q: A driver program for a printer is
mc.e: Drivers are system software.

mc.q: Task Manager is an example of
mc.e: Table 1.2.
mc.ez: 工作管理员是公用程序。

mc.q: Which is application software?
mc.e: DBMS is application software in Table 1.2.

mc.q: In an information system, 'process' refers to
o: a series of steps determining the order in which data is processed
mc.e: Definition of process.

mc.q: In the hospital process, which step must come right after the doctor writes a prescription, before the receipt?
o: System generates receipt for next patient
Pharmacist dispenses medicine and updates stock
mc.e: Order: doctor → nurse → pharmacist → receipt → statement.
mc.ez: 药剂师配药在收据之前。

mc.q: Who analyses the time, cost and feasibility of building a system?
mc.e: Systems analyst role.

mc.q: Who develops the system according to the design given by systems analysts?
mc.e: Programmer role.

mc.q: A teacher cannot log in to the school system and asks for help. Who should help?
mc.e: Technical support assists end users.

mc.q: Monitoring the network communication between computer systems is the job of the
mc.e: Network manager role.

mc.q: Data is best described as
o: a collection of unorganised facts which usually has no meaning on its own
mc.e: Definition.

mc.q: Information is
o: data put into context after processing, relevant to users
mc.e: Definition.

mc.q: Which pair shows data → information correctly?
o: Heights of students in 1A → name of the tallest student in 1A
Transcript of a speech → raw footage
Growth rate of net income → net income
mc.e: The others are reversed.

mc.q: For a photo of cats, which is information?
o: The number of cats in the photo
mc.e: Counting cats is the result of processing the photo.

mc.q: In the IPO cycle, calculating the average of entered marks is the
mc.e: Calculation = process.

mc.q: Which correctly orders the IPO cycle?
mc.e: Input-process-output.

k: A record is a collection of fields about one entity. A file is a collection of records with the same structure. A database is a collection of related files.

items.t: Database vs spreadsheet; DBMS and GUI
items.tz: 数据库 vs 电子表格；DBMS 与 GUI
k: A database is preferred for a large amount of data because a DBMS can organise, store and retrieve data efficiently and reduce data redundancy .
When unreliable or incorrect data is input, the output information will not be useful (GIGO).
Transposition error: the order of two adjacent characters is swapped.

items.tz: 数据有效性检验：目的与限制
k: Data validation ensures input data is reasonable and matches certain rules ; it cannot guarantee the data is accurate .

items.t: Presence check and fixed value check
items.tz: 存在检查与固定值检查
k: Presence check ensures there must be data in a required field . Fixed value check ensures data can only be one of specific values .
Type check ensures the data must be of a certain type .
Range check ensures the data is within a certain range . Length check ensures the length of the data matches certain criteria .

items.tz: 格式、一致性、唯一性检查
k: Consistency check ensures data is reasonable when compared to the data in other fields .
These designs reduce input errors because users can only select valid values .
A check digit is generated by a specific algorithm and appended to the end of the numeric data . If it does not match, the data is invalid .

items.tz: 香港身份证查数位算法
k: The HKID is valid if the weighted sum is divisible by 11.
A parity bit is added so that the total number of 1s is even (even parity) / odd (odd parity) . It cannot detect an even number of bit errors .
Verification checks whether the data is accurate and consistent when transferred from the source .
Validation ensures data is reasonable ; verification ensures data is accurate . Neither alone guarantees correct data.
A good database structure reduces data redundancy and enables communication between tables .
Records can be inserted, changed or deleted using SQL or a GUI ; data can be imported from .csv files to save time.

items.tz: 数据库功能：检索与排序
k: Data can be retrieved by specific criteria and sorted in ascending or descending order.

items.t: Index: how it speeds up retrieval
k: An index table contains the indexed field and a pointer to the related record ; since it is sorted , records can be found faster .
Indexing speeds up searching but needs extra storage and time to update the index when data changes.
In sequential access, data must be accessed in order from the beginning ; access time depends on the location of the data.
In direct access, each storage location has a unique address so data can be accessed directly without searching through other locations .
Magnetic tape is used for backup because it has a lower cost per unit capacity and longer lifespan , and backup is done sequentially .

mc.q: Which of the following statements about a check digit for a data item is correct?
o: The data item should not contain more than 8 characters.
The check digit cannot find all errors.
The check digit can correct errors.
The leading character of the data item should be a letter.
mc.e: A check digit detects many (not all) errors and cannot correct them.

mc.q: In a data transmission system, a parity check is applied. One of the following received codes is invalid. Which one is it?
mc.e: A, B, D have an even number of 1s; C has five 1s, so it breaks even parity.

mc.q: A computer system uses the Hong Kong identity card (HKID) number as a key field for managing accounts. Its check digit is used to detect input errors made by users. Which of the following input errors can usually be found by the check digit?
st: (2) Swap two digits in the HKID number.
(3) Input a wrong digit in the HKID number.
mc.e: Check digits catch transpositions and single wrong digits; another person's real number is still valid.

mc.q: An 8-bit code 10010011 is received without an error. The last bit is a parity bit. Using the same parity check, which of the following received codes has an error?
mc.e: Even parity: the correct code has an even number of 1s. 10011011 has five 1s, so it is wrong.

mc.q:
A university assigns a student number, YYYYNNNG, to every new student where

YYYY is the year of enrollment (e.g. 2015),
NNN is a 3-digit number ranging from 000 to 999, and
G is the area of study (1 stands for science and 2 stands for non-science).

According to this scheme, how many student numbers the university can assign in the year of 2015?
mc.e: 1000 values of NNN × 2 values of G = 2000.

mc.q: Mary produces daily sales reports for a supermarket on a word processor, using the data and charts stored in several spreadsheet files. The data and charts are updated frequently. Which of the following is most helpful to her?
mc.e: Linked objects (OLE) update automatically in the report when the spreadsheets change.

mc.q: A code consists of 6 digits where the digit on the far right is a check digit. The check digit method used for the code is that the sum of all 6 digits is divisible by 10. Which of the following codes is valid?
mc.e: 2+4+6+8+2 = 22; adding 8 gives 30, divisible by 10.

mc.q:
Consider the following values, P, Q and R.

P = 10001000₂
Q = 10001000₁₀
R = 10001000₁₆

Which of the following is correct?
mc.e: Same digits: the bigger the base, the bigger the value, so R (base 16) > Q (base 10) > P (base 2).

mc.q:
Peter uses a word processor to produce the rundown of a music performance, as shown below:
NameInstrumentTime
YvonnePiano2:00 pm
AlanViolin2:20 pm
NelsonFlute2:40 pm
SammyOboe3:00 pm
Which of the following can help Peter produce the rundown?
mc.e: Tab stops, columns or a table can all line up the three columns of text.

mc.q:
When creating an online email account, the following step needs to be completed.

Enter password: ********
Re-enter password: ********

What is the purpose of re-entering the password?
mc.e: Entering twice and comparing is double-entry verification.

mc.q: When changing the password of a school Intranet account, which of the following is an example of data verification?
o: Input a new password and a mobile phone number.
Input a new password that consists of at least one special character.
Input the old password and a new password.
mc.e: Double entry (typing the same data twice) is verification; C is a validation rule.

mc.q: Which of the following are appropriate for presenting a storyboard?
mc.e: A storyboard is a sequence of frames, which suits slides or a multimedia document, not a database.

mc.q: A device is sending 8-bit data in a network where the last bit is a parity bit. One of the following received data has an error. Which one is it?
mc.e: The others have an even number of 1s; 1010 0111 has five, so it breaks even parity.

mc.q:
A Hong Kong identity card number is wrongly entered into a computer system, as shown below:
Original numberWrong input
A123456(3)A213456(3)
Which of the following can help detect this error?
mc.e: Double entry catches the swapped digits, and the check digit (3) no longer matches.

mc.q: Which of the following processes is an example of data collection?
o: Inserting a bank card into an automated teller machine
Putting a photo on a scanner for scanning
Entering test marks written on a mark sheet into a spreadsheet
mc.e: Reading meters gathers raw data at the source.

mc.q:
A computer receives the three data sequences, shown below. Each sequence includes a parity bit. Two of the sequences are found to be corrupted during transmission.
First:  0101 0111
Second: 1101 0101
Third:  1110 1011
Which of the following best describes the situation?
o: Corrupted data sequence: The first and second, Parity check: Even
Corrupted data sequence: The second and third, Parity check: Even
Corrupted data sequence: The first and second, Parity check: Odd
Corrupted data sequence: The second and third, Parity check: Odd
mc.e: Count the 1s: first has 5, second 5, third 6. Two sequences are odd and one is even. If even parity was used, the first and second (odd count) are corrupted.

mc.q: Which of the following about mail merge are correct?
st: A database file can be used as the data source for mail merge.
A main document and a data source can be merged to produce a merged document.
The content of merge fields is inserted in the merged document when the merging completes.
mc.e: All three describe how mail merge works.

mc.q: Which of the following is not required for a mail merge using a word processor?
mc.e: Mail merge needs a data source, a main document and merge fields. Field length is not needed.

mc.q:
Peter wants to replace the short form, ‘LAN’, with the full name, ‘Local Area Network’ in a document, as shown below.
Before: “The High Land School wants to build a LAN to ...”
After: “The High Land School wants to build a Local Area Network to ...”
Which of the following search options in the REPLACE function of a word processor should Peter choose?
mc.e: Whole word stops 'Land' matching; match case stops 'lan' in other words. No wildcards or sounds-like needed.

mc.q: Which of the following shows the data hierarchy from the lowest level to the highest level?
mc.e: Field, record, file (table), database.
mc.ez: 由低到高：字段、记录、档案、数据库。

mc.q:
Which of the following statements about indexing is/are correct?
(1) Indexing increases the efficiency of data retrieval.
(2) Indexing reduces the storage size of a database.
(3) Index tables need to be updated when new records are added.
mc.e: Index tables take extra space, so (2) is wrong.
mc.ez: 索引需额外空间，(2) 错。

mc.q: A school's 8-digit student ID contains a check digit so that the sum of all 8 digits is divisible by 12. Which ID is valid?
mc.e: Digit sums: 22, 24, 20, 30. Only 24 is divisible by 12.
mc.ez: 只有 24 可被 12 整除。

mc.q: Using the same rule (sum of 8 digits divisible by 12), Ryan's ID is x646 0878. What is x?
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Checkpoint 2.1 Q2 (p.40, adapted options)

mc.q:
A feedback website replaces 1–5 sliders with text boxes. Which validations should be applied?
(1) Uniqueness check (2) Type check (3) Range check
mc.e: Ratings must be numbers within 1–5; different customers can give the same rating.
mc.ez: 评分要是数字且在范围内，可重复。

mc.q:
An operator mistyped 8-bit code 0010 0000 as 0100 000. Which can find this error?
(1) Double data entry (2) Parity check (3) Length check
mc.e: Both codes have one '1', so parity cannot detect; length 7 ≠ 8 and double entry would differ.
mc.ez: 1 的个数相同，奇偶检验无效。

mc.q: Which of the following statements about data validation is correct?
o: Data validation can detect and prevent all errors in data.
Parity checking is an example of data validation.
Proofreading is an appropriate validation method for gender.
Data validation always requires manual effort to complete.
mc.e: Parity check is done automatically by computers, so it is validation.
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC1 (p.54)

mc.q:
An app requires users to call the company using the input phone number to complete registration. Which error(s) can this prevent?
(1) Data source error (2) Runtime error (3) Transposition error
mc.e: A wrong/fake number (source) or swapped digits would make the call fail, so both are caught.
mc.ez: 号码错误或数字对调都会令来电失败。
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC2 (p.54)

mc.q: In a database storing personal information of students in a school, which might be the content of a record?
o: The personal information of every student in the school
The personal information of students in class 1A
The personal information of a particular student in 1A
The HKID number of a particular student in 1A
mc.e: A record = all fields about one entity. D is a field.
mc.ez: 记录是一个学生的全部资料。
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC3 (p.54)

mc.q: Which statement about data hierarchy is incorrect?
o: It is possible for a field to have many records.
It is possible for a file to have many records.
It is possible for a database to have many files.
It is possible for a database to have many fields.
mc.e: A record contains fields, not the reverse.
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC4 (p.54)

mc.q:
To check for transcription errors in an HKID, which can be used?
(1) Length check (2) Parity check (3) Check digit
mc.e: Parity check is for binary transmission, not HKID entry.
mc.ez: 奇偶检验用于二进制传输。
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC5 (p.54)

mc.q: A fixed-length product serial number looks like 0000123456789000. The most suitable validation rule is
mc.e: Stored as a number, leading zeros would be lost, so it must be text of length 16.
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC6 (p.54)

mc.q: Which is an example of data verification when changing a social media password?
o: Click a link sent to the user's email.
Require the user to login again.
Require a password longer than 8 characters.
mc.e: Inputting data twice is verification; D is a length check (validation).
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC7 (p.54)

mc.q: A database is frequently searched. Which measure cannot speed up searching?
o: Split the records into different files.
Perform indexing on the database records.
Copy the database's content into a spreadsheet file.
Store the database in a direct access medium instead of a sequential one.
mc.e: A spreadsheet is not more efficient for searching large data.
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC8 (p.54)

mc.q: A database backup is made on magnetic tapes. Which is correct?
o: An optical disc also supports only sequential access.
Retrieving one particular file will likely take longer than from a direct access medium.
The tape can replace hard disks in a computer.
Searching can be done quickly from the tape.
mc.e: Tape is sequential, so finding one file requires passing earlier data.
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC9 (p.55)

mc.q:
Advantage(s) of a drop-down list over a text box:
(1) Fixed value check is automatically applied. (2) Check digit is automatically calculated. (3) It reduces input error.
mc.e: Drop-down lists do not compute check digits.
mc.ez: 下拉清单不计算查数位。
mc.src: Textbook A1 Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC10 (p.55)

mc.q:
To validate an HKID number by check digit, we should:
(1) Ensure it starts with one or two letters. (2) Ensure its weighted sum is divisible by 11. (3) Ensure its length is no longer than 9.
mc.e: (1) is format check and (3) length check; only (2) is the check digit method.

mc.q: Four codes received, only one passes the parity check: which?
mc.e: 1s: 4, 6, 3, 2. Only one passes, so odd parity; C has 3.
mc.ez: 只有 C 有奇数个 1。

mc.q:
An email-change form shows: 'This field is required', 'Invalid email address' (missing @), 'Please enter the same email address'. Methods seen:
(1) Type check (2) Presence check (3) Verification by inputting data twice
mc.e: Missing '@' is a format check, not a type check.

mc.q:
For the field CNO (class number, Number) in a table for Class 1A students only, which checks are suitable?
(1) Uniqueness (2) Type (3) Presence
mc.e: Same class → unique; numeric → type; every student has one → presence.

mc.q: Which level of the data hierarchy is a collection of records sharing the same record structure?
mc.e: A file/table holds records of the same structure.

mc.q: In a STUDENT table displayed in a DBMS, a single column such as ENAME corresponds to a
mc.e: Columns are fields; rows are records.

mc.q: A school database contains STUDENT, TEACHER and CLASSROOM tables. The database is best described as
o: a collection of fields about one entity
a collection of records of one structure
mc.e: Database = collection of related files.

mc.q: Which is NOT a function of a DBMS described in this chapter?
mc.e: DBMS organises, stores and retrieves data.

mc.q: 'Garbage in, garbage out' means
o: the recycle bin must be emptied
unreliable input data produces useless output information
mc.e: GIGO describes the effect of bad input.

mc.q: A cashier records $15 as $51. This is a
mc.e: Two adjacent digits reversed.

mc.q: An OCR program reads capital letter 'I' as the digit '1'. This is a
mc.e: Misread data is a transcription error.

mc.q: A user registers with an email address that does not exist. Which is the best solution suggested?
o: Send an activation code to the email and ask the user to enter it
mc.e: Activation code confirms the source is real.

mc.q: Which is done by computers rather than humans?
o: Comparing a printout with exam papers
mc.e: Validation such as range check is automatic.

mc.q: Which statement about data validation is correct?
o: It guarantees input data is accurate.
It can only be applied once to each field.
It must be done by two operators.
It ensures input data is reasonable and matches certain rules.
mc.e: Validation checks reasonableness; several checks can apply to one field.

mc.q: An application form rejects an age of 10 because applicants must be older than 12. Which check?
mc.e: Value outside a range.

mc.q: A form rejects an applicant whose student ID has already applied. Which check?
mc.e: Duplicate values are not allowed.

mc.q: A form rejects '32/08/2025' as a date. This is mainly a
mc.e: Not a valid date value → type check (date picker prevents it).

mc.q: A form requires the return date to be later than the departure date. This is a
mc.e: Compared with another field.

mc.q: Which UI element allows multiple values to be selected while still applying a fixed value check?
mc.e: Checkboxes allow multiple selections.

mc.q: A date picker mainly provides which checks?
mc.e: Only valid dates in a fixed format.

mc.q: Which data type is most suitable for 'whether a student passes the test'?
mc.e: TRUE/FALSE.

mc.q: Which data type is most suitable for a student's height in metres?
mc.e: Needs decimal places.

mc.q: Why is the average of "八十五", "Seventy two", 91 and 79.5 an error?
o: The field mixes text and numbers, so arithmetic cannot be done
mc.e: Same field should share the same data type.

mc.q: Using the HKID algorithm (space=36, A=10…Z=35, weights 9 to 1, valid if weighted sum divisible by 11), what is the check digit of A123456?

items.tz: 文字、图像、声音及影片的数码化

mc.q: What are the 8-bit one's complement and 8-bit two's complement of the binary number 10110₂ ?
Which of the following actions involve converting data between digital and analog forms?
mc.e: Playing music is D→A, recording video is A→D; copying a file stays digital.

mc.q: Peter configures the colour quality of a display unit. Which of the following pixels are involved?
mc.e: Display pixels are made of red, green and blue sub-pixels (RGB).

mc.q: Which of the following statements about clicking a hyperlink in a presentation file is correct?
o: The hyperlink needs to involve HTTP.
A browser will not open when the hyperlink is “http://hkeaa.edu.hk/abc.doc”.
A PDF reader will usually open when the hyperlink links to a PDF file.
The presentation file will close automatically when the hyperlink links to another presentation file.
mc.e: The OS opens a linked file with its associated program, e.g. a PDF reader for .pdf.

mc.q:
Carol uses a digital camera to take photos of her school hall. The photos will be uploaded and shown on the school's web pages.
Which of the following image file types are suitable for her to use?
mc.e: Photos for the web: PNG and JPG support many colours and browsers; GIF has only 256 colours, TIFF is too big/not web.

mc.q:
Carol uses a digital camera to take photos of her school hall. The photos will be uploaded and shown on the school's web pages.
Before uploading a photo, what should Carol do?
o: If the file size of the photo is very large, she should divide it into small files for uploading.
She should reduce the photo size to fit the display.
She should adjust the resolution of the photo so that it is as high as possible.
She should adjust the number of colours shown in the photo to the highest number possible.
mc.e: Resize the image to the display size to cut file size and load time.

mc.q: Arthur inserts a video clip in a presentation file and sends an email with the file to Betty. When Betty opens the file, there is only text and the video is missing. Why?
o: The video is infected with a computer virus and has been removed by an antivirus program.
Linking instead of embedding is used when inserting the video in the presentation file.
The video is in MP4 format instead of AVI format.
mc.e: A linked video stays on Arthur's computer; only an embedded one travels with the file.

mc.q: With 8-bit two's complement representation, which of the following operations can produce an overflow error?
st: (3) Addition of a positive integer and a negative integer
mc.e: Overflow only happens when both numbers have the same sign; mixed signs can't exceed the range.

mc.q: When editing page numbers and hyperlinks in a document, which of the following statements is correct?
o: A browser must be open when clicking the hyperlinks.
The page numbers are printed as footnotes.
The hyperlinks facilitate the reading of the document.
The page numbers must start from 1.
mc.e: Hyperlinks let readers jump to related places, helping reading.

mc.q: Which of the following activities involve(s) the conversion of analog to digital data or vice versa?
st: (1) Talking to a friend on a mobile phone
(2) Listening to a radio programme over the Internet
(3) Copying a file from a DVD-R to a hard disk
mc.e: Voice on a phone and Internet radio both convert between sound (analog) and digital; copying a file stays digital.

mc.q: Increment the following numbers using 8-bit two's complement representation by 1. Which one will create an overflow error?
mc.e: 01111111 = +127, the largest positive value; +1 gives 10000000 = −128, an overflow.

mc.q: In a computer system, 10 bits are reserved for user identity codes and 54 bits are reserved for alias names. What is the maximum number of user accounts in the system?
mc.e: Accounts are identified by the 10-bit ID: 2¹⁰ = 1024.

mc.q: A WAV file, which is a common audio file, consists of a header. Which of the following items is stored in the header?
mc.e: The WAV header records format details like sampling rate, bit depth and channels.

mc.q: Mary converts the file animal.bmp to animal.jpg. Why?
st: (1) She wants to create a web page with this image.
(2) She wants to store the image in DVD-R.
(3) She wants to increase the resolution of the image.
mc.e: JPG is compressed and supported by browsers; conversion doesn't raise resolution and DVD-R can store BMP too.

mc.q: Arrange the following 4-bit numbers using two's complement representation in ascending order.

10,000 runners participate in a marathon competition. Each runner has a unique identity code stored in a RFID (radio-frequency identification) tag on one of his or her shoes. What is the minimum storage size required in each tag?
mc.e: 10,000 codes need 14 bits (2^14 = 16384), i.e. 2 bytes.

mc.q: The law firm uses optical character recognition (OCR) technology to convert digital images into document files. Which of the following attributes can highly affect the accuracy of the conversion during the scanning process?
mc.e: Higher scanning resolution gives sharper characters, so OCR is more accurate.

mc.q: What is the order of sizes of the three character sets, ASCII, Big-5 code and Unicode?
mc.e: ASCII has 128 characters, Big-5 about 13,000 Chinese characters, Unicode covers all scripts.

mc.q: During data input, which of the following can minimise input errors?
mc.e: Double entry (verification) and type check (validation) reduce input errors; two's complement is a number representation.

mc.q: Peter changes the format of his audio files from wav to mp3. What is his main reason for doing this?
o: Store the mp3 files in a network-attached storage (NAS) device.
Increase the quality of the audio data.
Reduce the storage space required for the audio data.
Create MIDI files for the audio data.
mc.e: MP3 is lossy compression, so the files are much smaller.

mc.q: In a device, 8 bits and 16 bits are used to store a character and an integer respectively. How many bytes are required to store the string 'HKDSE5'?
mc.e: 'HKDSE5' is a string of 6 characters (the 5 is a character), 1 byte each = 6 bytes.

mc.q: Mary creates a compressed file containing image files stored in several folders. She uploads the compressed file to the Internet for sharing with her friends. What are the benefits of using a compressed file?
st: (1) The folder structure can be maintained.
(2) Mary's friends can preview the images before downloading the compressed file.
(3) The compressed file can be protected by password.
mc.e: Archives keep folder structure and can be password-protected; images can't be previewed before downloading.

mc.q: 1111 1111 is an 8-bit number using two's complement representation. What is its decimal value?
mc.e: All 1s in two's complement is −1.

mc.q: Which of the following items can be included in a portable document format (PDF) file?
mc.e: PDF supports links, images and formatted text.

mc.q: When Mary chooses the file format for the slide show, which of the following is important?
mc.e: The public will use different devices, so the format must be cross-platform.

mc.q: Which of the following is/are the advantage(s) of using Unicode over Big-5 code?
st: (2) Unicode has a bigger character set.
(3) New characters can be defined in Unicode.
mc.e: Unicode's advantage is its much bigger character set covering many languages.

mc.q: Peter plans to upload the background music of his school web site but the web site has limited storage space. Which of the following file formats is appropriate?
mc.e: MP3 is a compressed audio format; WAV is uncompressed and AVI/MPEG2 are video.

mc.q: Which of the following are the major benefits of using Object Linking and Embedding (OLE) in office automation software?
st: (1) Data from different applications can be included in a single file.
(2) Data from different applications can remain synchronised.
(3) Data from different applications can be stored in the same folder.
mc.e: OLE puts data from other apps in one document and linked data stays in sync.

mc.q: Amy plans to upload her photos to cloud storage. What is the benefit of using JPG format instead of BMP format in this case?
o: Decreases the width and length of the photos.
Decreases the file size of the photos.
Increases the number of pixels in the photos.
Increases the number of colours in the photos.
mc.e: JPG is compressed, so files are smaller and upload faster.

mc.q: When a digital photo is printed on photo paper, the top and bottom parts of the photo paper are unused. What is/are the possible reason(s) for this?
st: (1) The aspect ratios of the digital photo and the photo paper are not the same.
(2) The file size of the digital photo is too large.
(3) The colour depth of the digital photo is too low.
mc.e: Blank strips appear when the photo's aspect ratio differs from the paper's.

mc.q: Which of the following actions involve the conversion of analog to digital data?
st: (1) Using software to convert a spreadsheet file into a PDF file
(2) Using software to convert speech to text
(3) Using a digital camera to take photos
mc.e: Speech (sound) and light are analog and get digitised; spreadsheet→PDF is digital to digital.

mc.q: The following calculations involve 8-bit numbers using two's complement representation. Which one will generate an overflow error?

The file sizes of the following original files are all 1 MB. Under normal circumstances, after compressing them, which compressed file has the largest file size?
Original filesCompressed files
A.testA.htmltestA.zip
B.testB.doctestB.zip
C.testC.txttestC.zip
D.testD.jpgtestD.zip
mc.e: JPEG is already compressed, so zipping it barely reduces its size.

mc.q:
Below is an example of Korean text:
안 녕 하 세 요
Which of the following character encoding methods can be used to represent Korean text?
mc.e: Only Unicode covers Korean characters; ASCII is English only and Big-5 is Traditional Chinese.

mc.q: A company designs a mobile application to process staff records. In each record, 10 bits are used to store staff numbers and 12 bytes are used to store Chinese names. How many staff records can the mobile application support?
mc.e: The number of records is limited by the unique staff numbers: 10 bits give 2^10 values.

mc.q: Which of the following is the 8-bit two's complement representation of the decimal value -8?
Mary inserts a hyperlink in a document file. What are the possible consequences when following the hyperlink?
st: (2) Jump to another page of this document.
(3) Jump to a page of another document.
mc.e: A hyperlink can point to any file, a bookmark in the same document, or another document.

mc.q:
A text file contains a character string '*IT*'. Peter uses a program to view the ASCII codes of the character string in the hexadecimal number system, as shown below:
2A49542A
How many bits are required to store the character string?
mc.e: 4 characters × 8 bits = 32 bits.

mc.q: Which of the following elements can be included in a PDF file?
mc.e: PDF can embed images, multimedia and hyperlinks.

mc.q: Which of the following statements about two's complement is/are correct?
st: (1) Overflow errors will not occur in arithmetic operations.
(2) The maximum value for an 8-bit number is 0111 1111.
(3) The minimum value for an 8-bit number is 1111 1111.
mc.e: Max 8-bit value is 0111 1111 (127); the minimum is 1000 0000 (-128), and overflow can still happen.

mc.q: Peter creates a school newsletter and posts it on a web page. The newsletter is in portable document format (PDF) instead of word document format because
st: (2) the newsletter will be displayed in the same way on any device.
(3) the resolution of images in the newsletter will be higher.
mc.e: PDF keeps the same layout on every device; word files can hold hyperlinks too.

mc.q:
Mary uses a text editor to enter the following 5 traditional Chinese characters and saves them in a text file. The file size is 10 bytes.
世上無難事
Which of the following statements about the text file is/are correct?
st: (2) ASCII code is used to represent the characters.
(3) The text file does not support Big-5 code.
mc.e: 10 bytes ÷ 5 characters = 2 bytes each (e.g. Big-5); ASCII cannot hold Chinese.

mc.q:
The file sizes of the following original files are all 10 MB. After converting them, which converted file has the smallest file size, under normal circumstances?
Original fileConverted file
A.testA.MP4testA.AVI
B.testB.MP3testB.WAV
C.testC.BMPtestC.JPG
D.testD.GIFtestD.BMP
mc.e: Only BMP → JPG goes from uncompressed to lossy compressed; the others get bigger.

mc.q: Which of the following decimal values is equivalent to 1010 0001 in 8-bit two's complement representation?
Amy uses JPG format instead of BMP format when scanning photos. What is/are the possible reason(s) for this?
st: (1) To decrease the file size of the photos
(2) To increase the number of pixels per photo
(3) To increase the number of colours displayed
mc.e: JPG compresses the image; it does not add pixels or colours.

mc.q: A company has 30 000 employees. Each employee has a staff number. What is the minimum number of bits required to represent the staff numbers?
Which of the following character sets can be used to represent simplified Chinese characters, traditional Chinese characters and English characters?
mc.e: Only Unicode covers both Chinese scripts and English; GB is for simplified Chinese.

mc.q: Mary sends an email with a document in PDF instead of DOC format. What is/are the possible reason(s) for this?
st: (2) The page layout of the document can be preserved.
mc.e: PDF keeps the layout fixed; DOC files can also be encrypted and hold multimedia.

mc.q: Which of the following additions of numbers in 8-bit two's complement representation will result in an overflow error?
mc.e: Overflow only happens when two numbers of the SAME sign give a result of the opposite sign. D: 1011 1010 = −70, 1100 0100 = −60, sum −130 < −128 → overflow (result 0111 1110 looks positive).

mc.q: The ASCII codes for the characters 'X' and 'Z' in hexadecimal are ________ and 5A respectively.
mc.e: X is two letters before Z: 5A − 2 = 58.

mc.q: Eva uses WAV format instead of MP3 format when recording music performance. What is/are the benefit(s) of this?
st: The file size of the audio file is larger.
mc.e: WAV is uncompressed, so quality is better. A larger file is a drawback, not a benefit. MP3 is just as cross-platform.

mc.q: John adds verbal annotations to a presentation file. Which of the following statements is/are correct?
st: The file size of the presentation increases.
The number of slides in the presentation increases.
Videos cannot be embedded in slides with a verbal annotation.
mc.e: Audio narration is stored in the file, so size goes up. Slide count doesn't change, and videos can still be embedded.

mc.q: Which of the following is not a multimedia file format?
mc.e: ZIP is a compressed archive format.

mc.q: Which of the following additions of 4-bit numbers using two's complement representation will result in an overflow error?
mc.e: C: 1100 = −4, 1011 = −5, sum −9 is below −8. Two negatives give 0111 (positive), so overflow.

mc.q: How many bits are required to represent an image of 8×8 black-and-white pixels?
mc.e: Black-and-white needs 1 bit per pixel: 8 × 8 × 1 = 64 bits.

mc.q: For a photo, the file size of its BMP image is larger than that of its JPG image because ________.
st: the BMP image cannot be shown in a browser
mc.e: BMP stores pixels without compression. JPG is also a bitmap, so (2) is not the reason.

mc.q: Why should characters be represented by character sets such as ASCII in computers?
st: As data in computers is stored in binary numbers
mc.e: Character sets give every character a standard binary code. They have nothing to do with encryption.

mc.q: In which of the following 8-bit representations will the addition of integers 01100000 and 01100000 result in an overflow error?
mc.e: Both are +96. 96 + 96 = 192, above the 8-bit signed maximum (127) in all three systems.

mc.q: What is/are the benefit(s) of creating a report in PDF format instead of DOCX format?
st: The text format can be preserved.
mc.e: PDF keeps the layout the same on any device. DOCX can also have hyperlinks and colour fonts.

mc.q: Which of the following image file formats support transparent background images?
mc.e: PNG and GIF support transparency. JPG does not.

mc.q: Which of the following regarding Unicode and Big-5 code is correct?
o: In a computer, the use of Big-5 code and Unicode depends on the operating system.
Big-5 code is used for representing characters in Chinese only.
Unicode is used for representing characters in English and other languages.
For web browsing, the use of a character set depends on the browser.
mc.e: Unicode covers English and most other languages. Big-5 also has English letters, and the character set is set by the file, not the OS or browser.

mc.q: After editing a document file, Jenny sends it to Peter for further editing. They use different word processors. In order to keep the document format the same, which of the following file formats should Jenny use?
mc.e: RTF keeps formatting and can be opened and edited in different word processors. PDF keeps format but is not meant for editing; TXT loses format.

mc.q: Mary wants to convert an audio file, abc.wav, to mp3 format. What should she do?
o: Use audio editing software to export the file in mp3 format.
Open the file with audio recognition software and save it as another file, abc.mp3.
Copy the file to an mp3 player.
mc.e: Changing format needs re-encoding by software; renaming the extension does not change the data.

mc.q: A colour photo is scanned using a scanner with 24-bit colours instead of 8-bit colours. This means that, in the chosen scanner,
st: more different colours can be scanned.
mc.e: Colour depth affects number of colours (2^24 vs 2^8) and file size, not resolution (dpi).

mc.q: A machine adopts two’s complement for the representation of 4-bit integer. Which of the following calculations is more likely to have an overflow error?
mc.e: 4-bit range is −8 to 7. A: 3+3=6, +2=8 overflows. Others stay within −8..7 at every step.

mc.q: Which of the following statements about character representation is/are correct?
st: GB code supports both traditional and simplified Chinese characters.
Unicode represents more characters than GB code does.
The concept of ASCII is no longer applicable because of the use of Unicode.
mc.e: GB is for simplified Chinese; Unicode covers far more characters; ASCII is still used (and is the first 128 code points of Unicode).

mc.q: To create a web page with Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese characters, which of the following methods is/are possible?
st: Use Unicode on the web page.
Use both BIG5 and GB on the web page.
Use BIG5 to represent traditional Chinese characters and image files to display simplified Chinese characters.
mc.e: One page can only declare one encoding, so mixing BIG5 and GB fails. Unicode covers both; images also work.

mc.q: What is the minimum number of bits needed to represent a set of 94 characters of 'Hangul' in the Korean language?
Jimmy wants to include some multimedia elements in a presentation file. Instead of copying the multimedia elements into the file, he uses hyperlinks. Which of the following descriptions is correct?
o: The presentation can include more multimedia elements.
The presentation can be more interactive.
The presentation can play video files immediately.
mc.e: Linked media stays outside the file.

mc.q: A 3-digit lock: each digit can be 1–9 or A–F. How many combinations?
A system allocates 8 bits for a student ID and 1 bit for gender. Maximum number of student accounts?
mc.e: Only the ID must be unique: 2^8=256.

mc.q: 70,000 contestants each need a unique identity code. Minimum storage per code?
mc.e: Need 17 bits → 3 bytes.

mc.q: Arrange I = 101010₂, J = 44₁₀, K = 2B₁₆ in ascending order.
A device uses codes 000–FFF (hex) for each character. How many bytes for 6 characters?
mc.e: 12 bits × 6 = 72 bits = 9 bytes.

mc.q: What is the decimal value of the 4-bit two's complement representation 1000?
mc.e: First bit place value −8.

mc.q: In a spreadsheet, 5-digit membership numbers for a sports club, 00001, 00002, ..., 99999, are entered in some cells. Which of the following cell formats should be used?
mc.e: Text format keeps the leading zeros; number formats would turn 00001 into 1.

mc.q: When editing numerical data in a spreadsheet, which of the following statements is correct?
o: Only relevant numerical data will be updated automatically.
Only relevant charts with the numerical data will be updated automatically.
Only relevant data in a single worksheet will be updated automatically.
Relevant data in multiple worksheets will be updated automatically.

mc.q: For a chain convenience store, in which of the following examples should 'what-if' scenarios in spreadsheets be used?

(3) Compares sales data from different branches.
mc.e: What-if analysis changes input values to see the effect: estimating expenses.

mc.q: In order for a factory manager to decide on the number of machines to be bought to produce pencils, he needs to consider time and cost constraints. What spreadsheet feature should he use to do this?
mc.e: What-if analysis (e.g. Goal Seek/Solver) tests different inputs under constraints.

mc.q:

SELECT CLASS, COUNT(*)
FROM STUDENT
GROUP BY CLASS

mc.q: For which of the following tasks should spreadsheet 'what-if' scenarios be created?
st: (1) Find the students who are awarded 90 marks or above in a Mathematics examination.
(2) Estimate the cost of a product produced by different manufacturers.
(3) Create a chart of monthly average temperatures.
mc.e: What-if scenarios compare outcomes under different inputs, such as different manufacturers' costs.

mc.q: Which of the following is spreadsheet software?

mc.q: Peter and Mary share a database file X and execute database queries, T1 and T2, respectively. Which of the following activities should the database management system not do?
st: (1) When T1 is reading X, T2 is reading X.
(2) When T1 is writing records in X, T2 is writing records in X.
(3) When T1 is deleting records in X, T2 is reading X.
mc.e: Simultaneous reads are safe; any write/delete while another accesses X can cause inconsistent data, so it must be locked.

mc.q: Assume that every household has a residential telephone number. In which of the following database applications could the residential telephone number be used as a key field?
mc.e: A Towngas account is one per household, so the household phone number is unique; people in one home share it.

mc.q: In a DBMS, a database designer designs a form for a clerk to use to enter data. Why does he choose to design a form?
o: More data can be entered at the same time.
The data entry uses less system computation time.
mc.e: A form gives the clerk a simple, friendly interface for data entry.

mc.q:
Which operations are performed by the following SQL command?
SELECT * FROM EXAM WHERE CLASS='1A' ORDER BY SCORE DESC
mc.e: WHERE filters, ORDER BY sorts.

mc.q:

Why are the employees' dates of birth instead of their ages stored?
o: The employees' privacy can be better protected.
Less memory is required for the storage.
The related SQL queries are simpler.
mc.e: Age changes every year; date of birth never does, so no updating is needed.

mc.q: Mr Lee wants to set up a cleaning service company to serve thousands of clients. He needs to process data about the service and create a monthly report for each client. Which software should he buy?
mc.e: Thousands of related records plus per-client reports suit a database.

mc.q:
Only one record is retrieved after executing the following SQL command. Why?
SELECT NAME, PHONE FROM EMPLOYEE
st: (1) There is only one record in EMPLOYEE.
(2) The content of NAME or PHONE in the remaining records is empty.
(3) There may be some other fields in EMPLOYEE.
mc.e: With no WHERE clause every record is returned (even empty ones), so the table must have one record; other fields may still exist.

mc.q: When creating a database table, what should be defined?
mc.e: Table structure = field names and data types; records are added later.

mc.q: When using a database management systems tool, what is the major purpose of a query?
o: Adjust the layout of a database report.
mc.e: A query selects/extracts the data that meet given criteria.

mc.q: A company uses a smart card system to record the attendance records of its employees. When an employee enters the company's office, he puts his smart card on a card reader and a new record is generated and stored in a database table. Which of the following fields are essential in the new record?
mc.e: Card number identifies the employee (name/department can be looked up); the entry time must be recorded.

What is the output of the following SQL command? SELECT CODE FROM MACHINE WHERE CLASS <> 'V1' AND PT < 80
mc.e: Only V3 (not V1) has PT < 80, giving CODE 17.

mc.q:
Study the following three SQL commands.

SELECT * FROM MEMBER
SELECT * FROM MEMBER WHERE age <= 40
SELECT * FROM MEMBER WHERE age >= 20

The results of the three SQL commands are the same. Which of the following is/are the possible cause(s)?
st: (2) The values of the field age in MEMBER range from 20 to 40 inclusive.
(3) age is the only field in MEMBER.
mc.e: An empty table, or all ages within 20–40, makes both WHERE clauses keep every record.

mc.q: What is the major benefit of using a form in a database management system?
o: Filters data in a single database table.
mc.e: Forms give a friendly layout for entering data.

What would be the output after executing the following SQL command?
SELECT MAX(WEIGHT) FROM PROD WHERE PSTAT <> 'S'
mc.e: Excluding PSTAT 'S' leaves weights 1,1,1,3,5; the maximum is 5.

What is/are the possible data type(s) for SID in STUDENT?
mc.e: SIDs have leading zeros (09544), so they must be stored as characters.

mc.q: Ms Li plans to design and produce student result slips using student information and examination marks stored in a database. What should she do?
o: Create hyperlinks to the database using word processing software.
Create SQL commands using spreadsheet software.
Import data and create a pivot table using spreadsheet software.
mc.e: Database report features format records into printable slips.

There are 6 records in a database table PET, as shown below:

What value(s) will be included in the output of the following SQL statement?

When creating a database table in database software, what should users usually set?
st: The data type of each field
mc.e: You define field data types and a primary key. You do not normally fix a maximum number of records.

mc.q: Peter wants to add the content in X.jpg and Y.xlsx to Z.docx using object linking. Which of the following statements about Object Linking and Embedding (OLE) is correct?
o: OLE does not apply to the file format of X.
The file size of X should be smaller than that of Z before Peter's action.
The file size of Z will be larger than that of Y after Peter's action.
Changes to data in Y can affect the subsequent printout of Z.
mc.e: Linking keeps a reference to the source file, so editing Y updates what Z shows/prints. Linking (not embedding) barely changes Z's size.

mc.q: What is/are the major advantage(s) of using a form for data entry in database software?
st: It shortens the execution time of SQL statements.
mc.e: Forms give a friendly layout with controls/validation → fewer input errors. They don't speed up SQL or save storage.

mc.q:
A supermarket uses a database table FRUIT, which stores fruit name FNAME and the corresponding quantity in stock QTY. Which of the following best describes the result of the query below?
SELECT FNAME
FROM FRUIT
WHERE QTY > 0
ORDER BY QTY DESC
o: Fruits are listed in descending order of fruit name.
Fruits are listed in ascending order of the quantity in stock.
Fruits with low quantities in stock are listed in ascending order of fruit name.
Fruits are listed in descending order of the quantity in stock.
mc.e: ORDER BY QTY DESC sorts by quantity, highest first. Only fruits in stock (QTY > 0) appear.

mc.q: Which of the following clauses should be used in a SELECT SQL command for displaying information where salary is greater than 5000 in ascending order of salary?
o: WHERE salary > 5000 AND ORDER BY salary
HAVING salary > 5000 OR ORDER BY salary
mc.e: Row conditions go in WHERE (HAVING is for groups). ORDER BY is a separate clause, not joined with AND/OR; ascending is the default.

mc.q: Peter wants to extract records with a data item within a range of values from a database. Which of the following SQL operators should he use?
mc.e: BETWEEN x AND y selects values in a range.

mc.q: Which of the following are common ways of showing record information in a database report?
st: Records with a table of contents
mc.e: Reports sort, filter and summarise records; a table of contents is not a typical report feature.

mc.q: What is the major purpose of using a form in a DBMS?
o: To filter data in a single database table

mc.e: A form facilitates data entry by simplifying the interface.

(4) The field properties of records
mc.e: Reports show sorted records and summaries.

mc.q: A table SALES stores WAREHOUSE, COMMODITY, QUANTITY and COST. Each warehouse stores each commodity once and quantities change regularly. Which is the most suitable primary key?
mc.e: The pair WAREHOUSE+COMMODITY is unique; QUANTITY changes and may repeat.

mc.q: The maximum quantity of a commodity is 400,000. What is the minimum storage size required for this field?
mc.e: 400,000 needs 19 bits (2^19 = 524,288), rounded up to 3 bytes.

mc.q: A sports-day table PARTICIPANT has EventID, StudentID and Name. Each student may join more than one event. What is the primary key?
mc.e: A student-event pair is unique; names may repeat.

It is possible to ensure REGISTERED in A has at most three characters
A occupies less storage space than B
It is impossible to have 'NONE' as a value of REGISTERED in B
mc.e: A Boolean takes less space than a 2–3 character string.

mc.q: Compared with managing records in a filing cabinet, a main advantage of a database is

mc.e: Manual handling is slow and error-prone.

mc.q: In datasheet view, typing data into the last row marked with an asterisk (*) will

mc.q: Which view of a table shows no records but lets the user manage the table structure?

mc.q: Which of the following CANNOT be done in datasheet view of an Access table?
o: Delete a whole field for all records
Delete one field of a single record only
mc.e: A field cannot be deleted for just one record; only its content can be cleared.
mc.ez: 不能只删除某一条记录的 field。

mc.q: Which of the following is TRUE about queries?
o: A query returns data in the form of a table
A query is stored in a field of a table
A query returns a single value like a formula
Running a SELECT query changes the data in the table
mc.e: Queries return a table; SELECT never changes data.

mc.q: A shop manager wants a printable list of products grouped by category with the total stock of each category. Which Access object is most suitable?
mc.e: Reports display and summarise data for printing.
mc.ez: Report 为打印而汇总数据。

mc.q: Which data type should be used for a student ID such as '034930'?
mc.e: A number field does not store leading zeros.
mc.ez: Number 不保留前导零，要用 Text。

mc.q: In Microsoft Access, how are TRUE and FALSE stored in a Yes/No field?
mc.e: True = -1, false = 0.

mc.q: By default, how many decimal places does the Currency data type store?
mc.e: Currency has 4 decimal places by default.

mc.q: Which statement about NULL is correct?
o: A primary key may store NULL once
mc.e: NULL means no data and has no data type.

Which of the following must be true for a primary key field?

(2) It cannot be NULL
(3) It must be of AutoNumber data type
mc.e: A primary key need not be AutoNumber.
mc.ez: Primary key 不一定是 AutoNumber。

mc.e: 0 means a digit is required; \- shows a literal hyphen.

mc.q: Which input mask accepts 'Apr' and 'Jan' and forces the first letter uppercase and the rest lowercase?
mc.e: > converts following letters to uppercase, < to lowercase.

mc.q: In an input mask, which character means “there can be a digit” (optional)?
mc.e: 0 = must be a digit; 9 = can be a digit.

items.tz: 输入-处理-输出周期 (IPO cycle)
k: Input devices capture data from the real world; the program processes the data (data in storage may be retrieved or updated); output devices output meaningful information.
Wired: USB port. Wireless: radio frequency (RF) e.g. 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi.
Each key is represented by a unique code which is sent to the computer when pressed. Numpad: for number input, password (PIN) input or calculation in banks / POS terminals.
Most typists are accustomed to QWERTY; it would take too much effort (time and cost of retraining) to learn another layout.

items.tz: 定点设备：动作追踪与位置追踪
k: Motion-tracking devices track the motion of the device; position-tracking devices track the position where the user points at the device.

items.t: Computer mouse (optical, LED vs laser, mechanical)
items.tz: 鼠标：光学、LED 与激光、机械
k: An optical mouse uses a light source and a light sensor to detect the change of reflected light. An LED mouse may not work on reflective or transparent surfaces; a laser mouse can.

items.tz: 轨迹球、游戏杆与驾驶盘
k: A trackball does not depend on the surface, needs less space and its position can be fixed.
A touchscreen is both an input and output device; easier to operate with better hand-eye coordination and needs less working space, but more expensive and cannot perform mouse-over.
A graphics tablet is controlled by a stylus and has many (up to 8000) pressure sensitivity levels, so it is suitable for drawing.

items.t: Audio input: microphone, speech recognition, MIDI keyboard
items.tz: 音频输入：麦克风、语音识别、MIDI 键盘
k: A microphone converts analog sound waves into electrical signals, which the sound card converts into digital audio. A MIDI keyboard stores musical notes and is not affected by ambient noise.
Higher pixel density (dpi) and colour depth give better image quality; a lossy format such as JPEG lowers quality; the interface does not affect image quality.

items.t: Calculating scanned image resolution and file size
items.tz: 计算扫描影像解像度及档案大小
k: Resolution = (width × dpi) × (height × dpi); file size = number of pixels × colour depth ÷ 8 bytes.
Use a scanner to capture the document as an image, then OCR software converts the image into a text file for editing/searching.

items.t: Digital camera, digital video camera and webcam
items.tz: 数码相机、数码摄像机与网络摄像头
k: A webcam connects directly to a computer and streams video online, at the cost of video quality; used for video conferencing and video monitoring.

items.t: Automatic input devices and optical readers
items.tz: 自动输入设备与光学阅读器
k: Automatic input devices input data with minimal human effort, reducing input time and input errors.
A barcode scanner converts a barcode into a sequence of characters (e.g. product ID); a QR code is a 2D barcode that can store text strings with any characters such as URLs.
OMR reads specific marks such as darkened circles quickly with fewer errors; it cannot recognise text, which requires OCR.

items.t: Magnetic stripe cards vs smart cards
k: Magnetic stripe cards are prone to damage and easily replicated; smart cards store data in a microchip and some communicate contactlessly via RFID/NFC.
A sensor reads a physical quantity (e.g. temperature, light, distance) from the environment and inputs it to the computer automatically.
Biometric characteristics are unique to each person, so they are used for authentication; but they are private data, raising privacy concerns.
Output devices output processed information, e.g. images, hard copies or sound. Touchscreens and headsets with microphones are both input and output devices.

items.t: LCD vs OLED monitors (and the LED misconception)
items.tz: LCD 与 OLED 显示器（LED 误解）
k: OLED does not need a backlight; it has a higher contrast ratio, wider viewing angle and is lighter. An LED monitor is an LCD with LED backlight.

items.t: Monitor specifications: screen size, resolution, aspect ratio, refresh rate, colour depth
items.tz: 显示器规格：尺寸、解像度、宽高比、刷新率、色深
k: Refresh rate is the number of times per second the screen updates its image (Hz); aspect ratio is the ratio of width to height.
Pixel density = √(width² + height²) ÷ screen size (in inches), measured in ppi.

items.t: Display ports: VGA, DVI, HDMI, DisplayPort
k: HDMI and DisplayPort support audio and high resolution; VGA and DVI do not carry audio.
A projector has an adjustable, larger screen size and is more portable, but its image is affected by ambient light.
Printer resolution is the dot density in dpi; printing speed is measured in pages per minute (ppm).

items.tz: 热敏、喷墨及激光打印机
k: Laser printers have a high printing speed and low cost per page; thermal printouts fade over time; inkjet printers have very high dot density but high cost per page.

items.t: Dot matrix printer, plotter and 3D printer
items.tz: 针式打印机、绘图仪与 3D 打印机
k: A dot matrix printer can print multipart forms to make multiple copies at the same time; a plotter draws high-quality vector drawings with continuously moving pens; a 3D printer produces physical objects from 3D models.
Speakers let a large group hear the sound with less risk of hearing damage; headphones provide privacy, do not disturb others and are less affected by ambient noise.

items.t: Business use: video conferencing and cashier service
items.tz: 商业应用：视像会议与收银服务
k: Video conferencing lets people hold live meetings remotely over the internet, saving transportation time and cost. Thermal printers are used for receipts because they print fast and quietly at low cost.

items.t: Electronic payment: POS terminal and self-service terminal
items.tz: 电子支付：POS 终端与自助终端
k: A self-service terminal is an upgraded POS terminal with a touchscreen and user interface, so customers can complete transactions by themselves, reducing labour costs.

items.t: Educational use: online lessons, library circulation, museum kiosks
items.tz: 教育应用：网上课堂、图书馆借还、博物馆资讯站
k: A self-charging terminal uses a smart card reader to validate the library card and a barcode scanner to read the book's barcode, so users can borrow books without librarians.

mc.q: Which of the following operations will enlarge the icons and text displayed on a visual display unit?
o: Reduce the number of colours displayed.
Increase the number of colours displayed.
mc.e: Fewer pixels on the same screen means each item takes up more space, so it looks bigger.

mc.q: A supermarket uses thermal printers instead of dot-matrix printers to print receipts. What are the major reasons for using thermal printers?
mc.e: Thermal printers are quiet and fast, but thermal receipts fade, so they're less durable.

mc.q: Mary wants to buy a keyboard for her tablet computer. Which of the following connections is/are commonly used for keyboards?
mc.e: Keyboards use USB or Bluetooth; fibre optics is for networks.

mc.q: Amy wants to buy a colour laser printer for use at home. What specifications should she consider?
mc.e: Printers are rated by ppm and dpi; lumens are for projectors.

mc.q: In a Point-Of-Sale system in a restaurant, which of the following is/are the reason(s) for using thermal printers to print receipts?
st: (1) The receipt printout can be kept longer.
mc.e: Thermal printers are quiet and fast, but thermal prints fade over time.

mc.q: (Refer to the specifications of computers X, Y and Z above.) Which computer(s) take(s) the shortest time to boot up?
mc.e: Z has both an SSD and a fast quad-core CPU.

mc.q: Which of the following can be the specifications of a scanner for scanning documents and photos?
mc.e: Scanners can have Wi-Fi (802.11n), a colour depth and onboard RAM as a buffer. All three are valid.

mc.q: Which of the following is/are the common specification(s) of a home use printer?
mc.e: Home printers have Wi-Fi (802.11n) and a resolution like 1200 dpi. Parallel ports are obsolete.

mc.q: Why would a fast food shop install a thermal printer instead of a laser printer to print receipts at the cashier?
st: The printout is black and white.
The printer is smaller in size.
The text on the printout will fade faster.
mc.e: A thermal printer is small, which suits a cashier. Laser printers can also print black and white, and fading is a drawback, not a reason.

mc.q: Which of the following is not a specification of a projector?
mc.e: rpm is a hard disk spindle speed, not a projector spec.

mc.q: Which of the following I/O devices are commonly used by a cashier in a restaurant?
mc.e: Card reader for payment, thermal printer for receipts.

mc.q: Which device is most suitable for creating comic illustrations?
mc.e: A drawing (graphics) tablet has pen control and many pressure levels.
mc.ez: 绘图板用笔并有压力感应。

mc.q: During online lessons, which of the following input devices may be used? (1) Monitor (2) Webcam (3) Printer
mc.e: Monitor and printer are output devices; only the webcam is input.
mc.ez: 只有 webcam 是输入设备。

mc.q: Which medium is NOT common in connecting headphones and computers?
mc.e: Headphones connect by USB, 3.5 mm jack or Bluetooth; Wi-Fi is uncommon.

mc.q: A powered drill should detect if it is overheated and halt automatically. Which sensor should be used?
mc.e: Overheating is a temperature reading.

mc.q: Which is an application of OCR software?
o: Converting printed documents into a digital text file
Checking differences between two document files
Checking whether answers on an MC answer sheet are correct
mc.e: OCR converts images of text into text. MC sheets use OMR; subtitles use speech recognition.
mc.ez: OCR 把文字影像转成文字档。

mc.q: An elderly man is not familiar with typing Chinese on a keyboard. Which device would NOT help him input Chinese characters?
mc.e: A printer is an output device.

mc.q: Which is/are true about virtual keyboards? (1) Primarily used in portable devices to save physical space (2) More ergonomic than physical keyboards (3) Only used in devices with touch screens
mc.e: Virtual keyboards lack tactile feedback (not more ergonomic) and can also be used with a mouse or in VR.

mc.q: Which printer is most suitable for printing credit card receipts that require a signature?
mc.e: Receipts at POS are printed by small, fast, quiet, cheap thermal printers.

mc.q: Which is an example of a printer's resolution?
mc.e: Printer resolution is dot density in dpi.
mc.ez: 打印机解像度以 dpi 表示。

mc.q: Jacky sees black strips on the left and right of a video on his monitor. Why?
o: The aspect ratio of the monitor and the video is different
mc.e: Letterboxing adds blank space when aspect ratios differ.
mc.ez: 长宽比不同导致加黑边。

mc.q: Advantage(s) of a computer mouse over a touchscreen? (1) Lower purchase cost (2) Better hand-eye coordination (3) Faster text input
mc.e: Touchscreens are more expensive; hand-eye coordination is the touchscreen's advantage.
mc.ez: 只有价钱较低是滑鼠的优点。

mc.q: Statements about magnetic stripe cards and smart cards: (1) Stripe cards are more durable (2) Smart cards store data in microchips (3) Smart cards are harder to replicate
mc.e: Stripe cards are prone to damage and easily replicated.

mc.q: Advantages of a projector over a monitor? (1) Works better outdoor during the day (2) Adjustable screen size (3) Easier to transport
mc.e: Projectors are badly affected by ambient light.

mc.q: Devices usually needed for video conferencing: (1) Microphone (2) Webcam (3) MIDI keyboard
mc.e: MIDI keyboards are for music input.
mc.ez: MIDI 键盘与视像会议无关。

mc.q: Leslie prints her certificate. Advantages of a laser printer over an inkjet printer? (1) No blur on contact with water (2) Cartridges do not clog (3) Printout lasts a very long time
mc.e: Inkjet printouts also last long, so (3) is not an advantage over inkjet.

mc.q:
Which of the following is/are usually found in a POS terminal?
(1) Barcode scanner
(2) Receipt printer
(3) Defragmentation software
mc.e: A POS terminal has card readers, a numpad, barcode/QR scanners and a receipt printer. Defragmentation software is not part of it.
mc.ez: POS 终端有读卡器、numpad、条码/QR 扫描器和收据打印机；没有磁碟重组软件。

mc.q: A company puts a QR code on a poster to promote its mobile app. What will the QR code most likely contain?
o: The URL for downloading the application
mc.e: QR codes usually store short text strings such as URLs; an app is far too large to fit.
mc.ez: QR code 通常储存网址等短字串；整个 app 放不进去。

mc.q: In the IPO cycle, which step may retrieve or update data in storage?
mc.e: During processing the program may read or update stored data.
mc.ez: 处理阶段读取/更新储存数据。

mc.q: A student enters weights into a spreadsheet, which draws a histogram. The histogram is the:
mc.e: The meaningful result output is information.

mc.q: Which correctly matches IPO with a smart thermostat? Temperature sensor reading → comparing with the set value → turning on the heater
mc.e: Sensor is input, comparison is process, heater is output.
mc.ez: 感应器输入、比较是处理、开暖炉是输出。

mc.q: A wireless mouse with a small USB dongle most likely uses:
mc.e: The dongle is an RF receiver.
mc.ez: USB 接收器是 2.4 GHz RF。
