mc.q: A keyboard layout is usually named after:
mc.e: e.g. QWERTY, AZERTY.

mc.q: A tenkeyless keyboard lacks:
mc.e: Tenkeyless = no numeric keypad.

mc.q: Why is QWERTY still dominant?
o: Users are accustomed to it and switching costs effort
mc.e: Habit/switching cost keeps QWERTY.

mc.q: Which is a position-tracking pointing device?
mc.e: Touchpad tracks where the finger is.

mc.q: An LED optical mouse fails on a glass table mainly because:
o: its sensor detects movement by changes in light reflected by the surface
glass is too smooth for the ball
mc.e: Transparent surfaces give little reflected-light change.

mc.q: Reasons mechanical mice are obsolete include: (1) heavy weight (2) low durability (3) high production cost
mc.e: All listed in the book, plus inconsistency on surfaces.

mc.q: Why are trackballs common on information kiosks?
o: Their position can be fixed and they need little space
mc.e: Fixed, space-saving, surface-independent.

mc.q: 'Multi-touch' means the device can:
o: be used by many users in turn
detect gestures with more than one finger at the same time
mc.e: Definition of multi-touch.

mc.q: Tapping on a touchpad normally functions as:
mc.e: Tap = left click.

mc.q: Which interaction is difficult on a touchscreen?
mc.e: No hovering cursor on a touchscreen.

mc.q: A graphics tablet differs from a touchscreen in that it:
o: is controlled by a pen and has many pressure sensitivity levels
mc.e: Pen + up to 8000 pressure levels.

mc.q: Which converts the electrical signal from a microphone into a digital audio file?
mc.e: The sound card digitises audio.

mc.q: A MIDI file stores:
o: musical notes or digitally sampled sounds
mc.e: MIDI stores note data, not a recording.

mc.q: A flatbed scanner captures an image by:
o: projecting white light and reading reflected light with image sensors
mc.e: Light reflected to sensors.

mc.q: An A4 page (8.3 × 11.7 in) scanned at 300 dpi gives a resolution of:
A 2490 × 3510 image with 24-bit colour, uncompressed, is about:

k: The motherboard serves as a platform to connect all the components. RAM stores data temporarily for processing; ROM stores firmware required to start a computer. Secondary storage stores data for future use. The PSU provides power to the computer.

items.t: Which components must a system unit have?
k: A dedicated graphics card is not a must, because an iGPU can be used instead. A hard disk is not a must, because an SSD can be used as secondary storage.
A motherboard is a circuit board that provides slots and ports for connecting electrical components and peripheral devices.
The CPU processes data and instructions and controls most of the operations performed by a computer. A cooling fan / heat sink prevents the CPU from overheating.

items.tz: GPU 与 CPU 的分别
k: A GPU is more specialised in graphic rendering, while a CPU handles various types of tasks. A GPU has more cores, so it is more capable of multitasking.
An iGPU is a GPU integrated into the chipset of a motherboard or a CPU. A graphics card provides higher graphics processing power.

items.t: Storage device overview: main memory vs secondary storage
items.tz: 储存设备概览：主存储器 vs 辅助存储器
k: Main memory (primary storage) refers to RAM and ROM. RAM is volatile: data disappears once the computer shuts down. Secondary storage is non-volatile.
A PSU converts high-voltage AC to low-voltage DC, which provides suitable power for the computer to operate.
The system bus transfers data and control signals between processors and various components. Bus width is usually the same as the word length of the CPU.

items.t: Control bus, address bus and data bus
k: The address bus carries memory addresses one-way from the processor. The data bus is two-way. The control bus carries control signals to ensure the correct timing of data transfer.

items.tz: SATA 与 PCIe 总线（增润）
k: SATA connects secondary storage devices; PCIe connects graphics cards, sound cards and NICs at high speed.
USB supports hot swapping: users can plug in or swap devices while the computer system is still operating.

items.t: CPU components: CU, ALU and registers
k: The CU decodes instructions and controls the data flow; the ALU performs arithmetic and logical operations.

items.t: Registers: CIR, PC, MAR, MDR, accumulator
k: The PC stores the address of the next instruction to be executed. The MAR stores the memory address to be read from or written into. The MDR stores the data read from or written into memory.
Cache memory temporarily stores data or instructions that are expected to be accessed most frequently, so the CPU accesses them faster than from RAM.
The instruction is fetched from main memory, decoded by the CU, executed by the ALU, and the result is stored.

items.t: The seven steps of the machine cycle
k: The memory address in the PC is copied to the MAR; the PC is incremented; the address is sent to main memory via the address bus; the instruction is transferred to the MDR via the data bus; then copied to the CIR.

items.t: Visualising register contents in the machine cycle
items.tz: 机器周期中寄存器内容的变化
k: The PC is updated to the address of the next instruction before the current instruction is decoded and executed.
Clock rate is the number of clock cycles a CPU performs in one second. A higher clock rate usually gives better performance, but the relationship is not linearly proportional.
A CPU with more cores usually performs better in multitasking, but the relationship with processing speed is not linearly proportional.
Word length is the number of bits processed by a CPU each time. A longer word length allows more memory locations to be addressed.

items.t: Misconception: 64-bit is not twice as efficient as 32-bit
items.tz: 误解：64 位不是 32 位的两倍效率
k: The advantage of a 64-bit processor is that it can address more memory; the relationship with performance is not linearly proportional.
RAM is volatile and stores data temporarily for processing. Larger RAM allows more data to be processed without accessing slower secondary storage.

items.tz: 只读存储器 ROM 与 BIOS
k: ROM is non-volatile and stores the firmware (BIOS) required to start a computer.

items.tz: ROM 的种类及 UEFI（增润）
k: EPROM can be erased by ultraviolet light; EEPROM can be erased electrically. UEFI is an alternative firmware to BIOS.

items.tz: 存取方法：顺序存取与直接存取
k: In sequential access, data is searched sequentially from the beginning, so the access rate varies with location. In direct access, each position has a unique address, so data is accessed directly.

items.t: Magnetic storage: magnetic tape and hard disk
k: Magnetic tape has a low data access rate due to tape winding, so it is used for backup. A hard disk uses read/write heads to move directly to data.

items.t: Solid-state storage: SSD, memory card, USB flash drive
items.tz: 固态储存：SSD、记忆卡、U 盘
k: An SSD has no moving parts, so it is more durable and consumes less energy than a hard disk, but it has a higher unit price per capacity.
Data is represented by grooves and read by laser beams; scratches may divert the laser and corrupt data.
Always link the property to the scenario, e.g. SSD: higher data access rate and more durable as it has no moving parts .
RAID combines multiple storage devices to improve the data transfer rate and reduce the chance of data loss due to device failure.

items.t: Network storage: NAS and cloud storage
items.tz: 网络储存：NAS 与云端储存
k: NAS allows users on a LAN to read and write at the same time. Cloud storage allows users to access data anytime and anywhere with an Internet connection, but may need regular payment.
The higher the storage is located in the hierarchy, the higher its data access rate, the smaller its storage size and the higher its unit price per capacity.
A desktop has higher computing power and larger storage but low portability; a tablet has high portability but lower computing power.
e.g. Model B is more suitable because it has a dedicated graphics card, which provides higher graphics processing power for video editing.
Storage devices are developing towards larger storage size, higher data access rate and smaller physical size.

mc.q: Which of the following is the main development trend for display units in desktop computers?
mc.e: Monitors moved from CRT to LCD/LED mainly to save energy (and space).

mc.q: Carey wants to upgrade the DDR II 2G 667 MHz RAM of her computer to DDR III 2G 1333MHz RAM with a higher data transfer rate. Which of the following features should be considered?
mc.e: DDR3 needs a motherboard with DDR3 slots/chipset support.

mc.q: What is the main purpose of having a memory cache in a CPU?
o: It increases the total memory storage capacity.
It supports multi-core processors on the motherboard.
mc.e: Cache holds frequently used data close to the CPU, so processing is faster.

mc.q: The 64-bit version of an operating system is better than the 32-bit version because
o: the processing power of the CPU is higher.
the operating system can address more memory locations.
the data transfer rate of RAM is higher.
mc.e: A 32-bit OS can address only about 4 GB; 64-bit addresses far more memory.

mc.q: In an instruction fetch cycle, which of the following registers are involved?
mc.e: Fetch: PC → MAR, instruction comes into MDR → CIR. The accumulator is used in execution.

mc.q: A charity organisation wants to donate laptop computers to the children in developing countries for e-learning. With a limited budget, only one item in the original specifications can be upgraded, as shown below. Which of these is the most appropriate?
o: Original: No network card → Upgrade: 802.11n network interface card
Original: Built-in graphics card → Upgrade: graphics card with 2G RAM
Original: Dual-core CPU → Upgrade: Quad-core CPU
Original: DVD disc drive → Upgrade: Blu-ray disc drive
mc.e: E-learning needs network access; without a network card the laptops can't go online.

mc.q: A quad-core processor is generally better than a dual-core processor because
o: more instructions can be executed at the same time.
a graphics processing unit (GPU) can be installed.
mc.e: More cores = more instructions processed in parallel.

mc.q: Mary connects a new USB flash drive to a computer. She does not need to install a driver program for the flash drive. Why not?
o: A USB flash drive does not require a driver program.
The flash drive uses the same driver program as the hard disk.
The computer does not connect to the Internet.
The operating system in the computer has the driver program for the flash drive already.
mc.e: Every device needs a driver; the OS already includes a generic USB mass-storage driver.

mc.q: Joseph installs network-attached storage (NAS) in the office network that operates as a file server. If he installs more cache memory in the NAS, which of the following can be greatly improved?
mc.e: Cache speeds up reading/writing data, so throughput improves.

mc.q: Which of the following components in a Central Processing Unit (CPU) fetches an instruction from the main memory?
mc.e: The control unit directs the fetch step; PC and MAR only hold addresses.

mc.q: Which of the following statements about cache memory in CPU are correct?
st: (1) It is better than main memory in terms of access speed.
(2) It stores frequently-used data and recently-used data.
mc.e: Cache is fast and holds frequently/recently used data, but it is volatile.

mc.q: Peter finds that when editing video files, the performance of his home computer is better than that of his office computer. Which of the following is/are the possible cause(s) for this?
st: (1) The read/write access speed of a hard disk
mc.e: Disk speed and CPU clock rate affect video editing; ROM size does not.

mc.q: The clock rate of a CPU is 2 GHz. Which of the following statements is correct?
o: The CPU executes 2×10⁹ instructions in a second.
The CPU performs 2×10⁹ clock cycles in a second.
The cache memory of the CPU transfers 2×10⁹ instructions in a second.
The ALU of the CPU takes 2×10⁹ clock cycles for an instruction.
mc.e: 2 GHz means 2×10⁹ clock cycles per second; instructions may take several cycles.

mc.q: Peter upgrades a server by replacing the hard disk with a solid-state disk (SSD). Which of the following properties of SSD benefit(s) the upgrade?
mc.e: SSDs are faster and use less power; smaller capacity is not a benefit.

mc.q: When a personal computer is turned on, it loads data from the ROM and checks that all major components are functioning properly. ROM cannot be replaced by RAM in this process because
o: the storage size of RAM is smaller.
the data transfer rate of RAM is lower.
mc.e: RAM loses its contents when power is off, so the boot program must be in ROM.

mc.q:
Consider the following steps in a machine cycle for a particular instruction:

(1) Executes the instruction.
(2) Writes data in memory.
(3) Translates the instruction into the operation code and operands.
(4) Retrieves the instruction from memory.

What is the correct order of the steps?
mc.e: Fetch (4) → decode (3) → execute (1) → store (2).

mc.q: A computer is used to edit videos. Which of the following specifications have a significant impact on the performance of the computer?
mc.e: RAM size and CPU speed matter; USB port count does not.

mc.q: Which of the following statements about the registers in CPU is correct?
o: Their read/write data transfer rates are high.
They are used as secondary storage.
Their total storage size is usually larger than 1 GB.
mc.e: Registers are the fastest, tiny storage inside the CPU, each with its own job.

mc.q: Why is a solid state drive (SSD) commonly used in mobile devices instead of a hard disk drive?
o: The physical size of a SSD is smaller.
The storage capacity of a SSD is smaller.
The data access rate of a SSD is lower.
Mobile devices do not support hard disk drives.
mc.e: SSDs have no moving parts and are small and light, which suits mobile devices.

mc.q:
Read the configuration of a desktop computer below:
• Intel® Core™ i7 CPU
• 16GB DDR4 RAM
• 1TB SSD
• 802.11ac Wi-Fi
What information can be found out from the configuration?
st: (1) The viewable size of the display unit
(2) The maximum data transfer rate of a wireless network
(3) The time to start up a computer
mc.e: 802.11ac fixes the maximum Wi-Fi rate; no display is listed and start-up time is not given.

mc.q: Which of the following are the latest trends in hard disk drive development?
mc.e: Drives are moving to lower power use and longer life; built-in software is not a trend.

mc.q: Which of the following statements about the fetch-decode-execute cycle in a CPU is correct?
o: Registers are used in the cycle.
The cycle is an assembly language program.
The sequence of the instructions in the cycle mainly depends on the CPU clock rate.
The cycle is mainly used to perform arithmetic operations.
mc.e: The cycle uses registers such as the PC, MAR, MDR and IR.

mc.q: Susan plans to buy a new computer for video editing. In general, which of the following is the least important factor that she should consider?
mc.e: Video editing needs CPU power, RAM and storage; USB port count matters least.

mc.q: Which of the following statements about the accumulator in a CPU is correct?
o: It is used by the Arithmetic and Logic Unit (ALU) for calculation.
It is used by the Control Unit (CU) to store a memory address temporarily.
It stores the memory address of the next instruction to be executed.
It controls the flow of data in a bus.
mc.e: The accumulator holds the ALU's working results.

mc.q: What is the possible outcome of lowering the clock rate of a CPU in a desktop computer?
o: Enhances the performance of the WiFi connection.
Increases the protection of the computer from hacking.
mc.e: A slower clock uses less power.

mc.q: Arrange the following in ascending order by data transfer rate.
mc.e: SSD is slowest, then RAM, then cache.

mc.q:
Answer Questions 14 and 15 with reference to the following specifications of computers X, Y and Z. All computers use the same operating system.
XYZ
CPUQuad-core, 2.8 GHzDual-core, 1.8 GHzQuad-core, 2.4 GHz
RAM4 GB2 GB4 GB
Storage device2TB hard drive512 GB SSD512 GB SSD
NetworkLAN port (1000 Mbps)802.11ac WiFiLAN port (1000 Mbps)
802.11ac WiFi
Which computer(s) has/have the best computational power?
mc.e: X has a quad-core CPU at the highest clock rate.

mc.q: Which of the following is not an advantage of an SSD over a hard drive?
mc.e: Hard drives also support random (direct) access.

mc.q:
Consider the following instruction.
AddressInstructionDescription
1000STORE 1111Store the content of the accumulator into the main memory with the address 1111
In the fetch-decode-execute cycle, what does 'fetch' do?
o: Obtains the instruction from the main memory with the address 1000.
Obtains the instruction from the main memory with the address 1111.
Obtains the content of the accumulator.
Calculates the address of the next instruction by using the control unit (CU).
mc.e: Fetch reads the instruction stored at its own address, 1000.

mc.q: Which of the following only support(s) sequential access?
mc.e: Tape must be read in order; discs and flash allow direct access.

mc.q: Which of the following statements about the components in a computer is not correct?
o: The arithmetic and logic unit (ALU) is used to perform arithmetic operations.
The accumulator is a register that stores arithmetic and logic results.
The data transfer rate of registers is higher than that of the main memory.
Data buses are used to transfer control signals between the main board and input/output devices.
mc.e: Data buses carry data; control signals travel on the control bus.

mc.q: Which of the following is a recent development in CPU?
o: Decreasing the number of processing units
mc.e: Of the options, only a higher clock rate is a real trend (along with more cores and lower power).

mc.q: Peter wants to buy a computer for using multimedia learning software packages. Which of the following is the least important factor?
mc.e: ROM only holds firmware (BIOS/UEFI); its size doesn't affect running software.

mc.q: What are the advantages of using an e-book reading device instead of a tablet computer to read e-books?
mc.e: E-ink readers use little power and are light; tablets are more powerful.

mc.q: The instruction of the assembly language 'LOAD 1000' is executed in a CPU. Which of the following components decodes the instruction?
mc.e: The Control Unit fetches and decodes instructions. ALU does arithmetic/logic.

mc.q: A standalone computer runs slow when working on database software. Which of the following hardware components should be upgraded?
mc.e: More RAM helps. ROM is not upgraded for speed, and a standalone computer does not use the network.

mc.q: Which of the following statements about direct access on a storage device are correct?
st: Writing the data of a file starts from the beginning of the storage device.
In general, the seek time to search for a file is faster than that of sequential access.
It is more commonly used in hard disks than sequential access.
mc.e: Direct access jumps straight to the data, so seeking is faster, and hard disks use it. It does not need to start from the beginning.

mc.q: For a CPU with the specifications of 16 cores, 5 GHz and a 30 MB cache, which of the following are correct?
st: The clock rate of the CPU is 5 GHz.
The maximum number of programs that the CPU can handle at the same time is 16.
The CPU accesses data in the cache memory faster than that in RAM.
mc.e: 5 GHz is the clock rate and cache is faster than RAM. Cores do not limit the number of programs; multitasking can run many more.

mc.q: Which of the following is the main function of a network interface card in a computer?
o: To connect to a wired router and project Wi-Fi signals to a designated area.
To direct data packets from one network to another network.
To filter and forward data packets from the computer to another device.
To send and receive network signals.
mc.e: A NIC sends and receives network signals. A is an access point, B a router, C a switch/firewall.

mc.q:
In a computer, the performance of each individual task is shown below:
TaskPerformance
Execution of database queriesPoor
Online meetingsSmooth
Playing of 4K videos on a hard diskFair
Which of the following components should be upgraded?
mc.e: Online meetings are smooth, so the network is fine. Slow queries point to the CPU and weak 4K playback to the display card.

mc.q: John has just connected a new USB printer to a computer. Why is he able to use the printer immediately?
o: The RAM size of the printer is large enough to store the data for printing.
The operating system of the computer already has a driver program for the printer.
USB printers do not need driver programs.
There is a built-in CPU in the printer to manage the printing.
mc.e: Plug and play works because the OS already has a suitable driver.

mc.q: In which of the following hardware components can files be accessed in direct access mode?
mc.e: Only magnetic tape is sequential access.

mc.q: A device is installed in a vehicle to record the traffic using a camera. Which file format and storage medium are appropriate for the device?
o: File format: AVI, Storage medium: DVD-RW
File format: AVI, Storage medium: Flash memory card
File format: WMA, Storage medium: DVD-RW
File format: WMA, Storage medium: Flash memory card
mc.e: AVI is video (WMA is audio only). Flash cards are small, shock-resistant and rewritable in a moving car.

mc.q: Which of the following data will be stored in the program counter in a machine cycle?
mc.e: The PC holds the address of the next instruction.

mc.q: Which of the following are the main functions of a CPU?
st: Providing an interface between user and system.
mc.e: CPU does ALU work and executes instructions. Permanent storage is secondary storage; user interface is the OS.

mc.q: Which of the following statements about registers in a CPU is/are correct?
st: Cache memory is a kind of register.
Accumulator is a kind of register.
mc.e: Register size depends on the CPU (not fixed at 8 bits); cache is separate memory, not a register.

mc.q: Which of the following is not a specification of a CPU?
mc.e: Rotational latency describes a hard disk.

mc.q: When compared with normal PCs, which of the following statements about Personal Digital Assistants (PDA) is correct?
o: Only small files can be stored.
The operating system requires less system memory to operate.
The operating system should be re-installed when the system crashes.
Data must be stored in an external flash memory card.
mc.e: Mobile OSs are designed to run in less memory.

mc.q: The specification of a CPU, 3.0 GHz, indicates __________________.
mc.e: Clock rate is a measure of processing speed.

mc.q:
Which of the following components must be found in a system unit?
(1) RAM
(2) Hard disk
(3) Dedicated graphics card
mc.e: RAM is essential; an SSD can replace a hard disk; an iGPU can replace a graphics card.
mc.ez: RAM 必須；硬碟可用 SSD 代替；顯示卡可用 iGPU 代替。

mc.q: Which of the following statements about CPU and GPU is correct?
o: A GPU always contains RAM while a CPU does not.
A CPU has a cooling fan while a GPU does not.
A CPU cannot process graphics while a GPU can.
A GPU can be integrated into a CPU.
mc.e: An iGPU is a GPU integrated into a CPU (or motherboard chipset).
mc.ez: iGPU 就是整合入 CPU 的 GPU。

mc.q:
Which of the following statements about buses is/are correct?
(1) An SSD can be connected to a computer through SATA bus.
(2) An address bus transfers memory addresses from various components to processors.
(3) A data bus transfers data only from processors to various components.
mc.e: Address bus goes processors → components; data bus is two-way.

mc.q:
Kevin wants to connect a keyboard to his computer. Through which of the following ports can he connect?
(1) VGA port
(2) HDMI port
(3) USB port
mc.e: VGA and HDMI are for display units.

mc.q: What is the advantage of using an integrated sound card over a dedicated sound card?
mc.e: Integrated interfaces replace more expensive external cards, lowering cost.

mc.q: Which type of system bus transfers control signals from processors to components?
mc.e: Control bus carries control signals one-way from processors.
mc.ez: 控制訊號由 control bus 傳送。

mc.q:
Which of the following store memory address in a machine cycle?
(1) PC
(2) MAR
(3) RAM
(4) CIR
mc.e: PC holds the next instruction's address; MAR holds the address being accessed.
mc.ez: PC 和 MAR 存位址。

mc.q:
Macy's computer runs a machine-learning face-recognition program faster than the school's computers. Possible reasons?
(1) The number of ports on the motherboard
(2) The number of cores in the CPU
(3) The number of clock cycles a CPU performs in one second
mc.e: Ports do not affect performance; cores and clock rate do.

mc.q: Which component in a CPU decodes an instruction during a machine cycle?
mc.e: The CU decodes; the ALU executes.

mc.q: Which of the following must be the result of reducing the word length of a CPU?
o: The number of memory locations the CPU can address is reduced
mc.e: Shorter words mean fewer addressable locations; other effects are not guaranteed.
mc.ez: 字長縮短，可定址位置必定減少。

mc.q: Ryan replaces 8 GB DDR3 RAM with 16 GB DDR4 RAM but fails. Which is the possible reason?
o: The memory size is too large for the CPU.
The clock rate of the new RAM is too high for the CPU.
The ROM does not support DDR4 RAM.
The motherboard does not support DDR4 RAM.
mc.e: RAM versions differ in shape and must fit the motherboard slot.
mc.ez: RAM 版本要配合主機板插槽。

mc.q: Data in RAM is used for processing and updated frequently. Why can it not be stored in ROM instead?
o: ROM has a lower data transfer rate.
ROM has a smaller storage size.
mc.e: Frequently updated data needs rewritable storage.
mc.ez: 經常更新的資料需要可改寫的儲存。

mc.q:
Which of the following statements about RAM is/are correct?
(1) Its data access rate is higher than that of secondary storage.
(2) Its data access rate is higher than the CPU cache.
(3) Its data disappears once the computer shuts down.
mc.e: Cache is faster than RAM.

mc.q: Paul carries about 12 GB of files between home and office and changes them regularly. Which device should he use?
mc.e: Enough capacity, rewritable, no extra drive, portable.

mc.q:
Grace, a graphics designer, upgrades her desktop. Which greatly affect performance?
(1) Storage size of RAM
(2) Storage size of ROM
(3) Clock cycle of the CPU
(4) Weight of the computer
mc.e: ROM only holds BIOS for booting; weight is irrelevant.
mc.ez: ROM 只在開機用；重量無關。

mc.q: Arrange in descending order by data access rate: (1) Cache memory (2) Flash memory (3) Register
mc.e: Register > cache > flash.
mc.ez: 暫存器 > 快取 > 快閃。

mc.q:
What are the advantages of a tablet over a desktop computer to watch videos?
(1) More portable
(2) Larger screen size
(3) Higher computing power
(4) Lower energy consumption
mc.e: Tablets are portable and use less energy, but have smaller screens and less power.

mc.q:
Which are the main focus of technology development for a smartphone?
(1) Higher resolution
(2) Higher computational power
(3) More USB ports
mc.e: More USB ports is not a trend.
mc.ez: 更多 USB 埠不是趨勢。

mc.q: Which of the following must be included in a system unit?
mc.e: Graphics card, hard disk and RAID all have alternatives or are optional.
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC1 (p.88)

mc.q: Which pair of component and function is correct?
o: Main memory: stores data temporarily for processing
Processor: connect all computer components together
Secondary storage: stores the programs necessary for turning on the computer system
mc.e: Startup programs (firmware) are in ROM.
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC2 (p.88)

mc.q: Tommy builds a computer to produce 3D animation. Which specification can highly affect the rendering speed?
mc.e: Clock rate affects processing speed; storage size and slot count do not.
mc.ez: 時鐘頻率影響處理速度。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC3 (p.88)

mc.q: Ben backs up 500 GB of videos into a hard disk instead of an SSD. Possible reason?
o: Hard disks are usually shock resistant.
Data access rates of hard disks are higher.
Unit price per capacity of hard disks is usually lower.
mc.e: Hard disks are cheaper per GB; SSDs are also non-volatile.
mc.ez: 硬碟每 GB 較便宜。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC4 (p.88)

mc.q:
Which storage devices support direct access?
(1) Hard disk
(2) Solid-state drive
(3) Floppy disk
mc.e: All have uniquely addressed positions.
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC5 (p.88)

mc.q: Which statement about computer components is correct?
o: The program counter stores the address of the next instruction.
The MAR stores the data read from or to be written into the memory address.
The accumulator stores the current instruction being executed.
The control unit performs logical operations.
mc.e: B is MDR, C is CIR, D is ALU.
mc.ez: B 是 MDR，C 是 CIR，D 是 ALU。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC6 (p.88)

mc.q: Which is not involved in a machine cycle?
o: Updating the address stored in the program counter
mc.e: Instructions come from main memory; MAR only holds the address.
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC7 (p.88)

mc.q: Which is not a usage of a USB port?
o: Installing operating system from a flash drive
Storing data in a flash drive
mc.e: Defragmentation is a utility function, not a port usage.
mc.ez: 硬碟重組不是 USB 用途。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC8 (p.88)

mc.q: Which has the highest data access rate?
mc.e: Top of the memory hierarchy.
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC9 (p.89)

mc.q: Which is a trend of GPU development?
mc.e: Hardware trends aim at more power and higher efficiency.
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC10 (p.89)

mc.q: Which statement about volatile memory is correct?
o: Data in the memory will not be processed.
Volatile memory stores the system firmware.
Data in the memory disappears once the computer shuts down.
mc.e: Firmware is in non-volatile ROM.
mc.src: Textbook B Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC11 (p.89)

mc.q: Tommy has a 3D printer. Which of the following is usually stored in its RAM?
o: The data for the 3D model that is to be printed
mc.e: Peripheral devices keep the data being processed (the job) temporarily in RAM.
mc.ez: 打印机的 RAM 暂存正在处理的数据，即要打印的 3D 模型。

mc.q: Which of the following is usually stored in the ROM of a 3D printer?
mc.e: ROM stores fixed firmware data that is not rewritten in daily use, such as factory calibrated measurements.
mc.ez: ROM 储存固定、平时不改写的 firmware 资料，例如出厂校准数据。

mc.q: Which pair of component and function is correct?
o: Secondary storage: redistributes the order of files to increase access rate
Processor: stores data temporarily for processing
mc.e: Main memory includes ROM, which stores firmware. Redistributing files is defragmentation software; RAM stores data temporarily; VGA is for display units.
mc.ez: Main memory 包括 ROM，储存 firmware。其余配对错误。

mc.q: Why is a 64-bit operating system better than a 32-bit one?
o: It can address more memory locations.
The access speed of the secondary storage will be higher.
The computing power of the CPU is higher.
mc.e: A longer word length lets the computer address more memory; it does not add memory or make storage faster.
mc.ez: 较长 word length 可定址更多记忆体位置；不会增加记忆体或加快储存。

mc.q: A music studio wants to upgrade hardware to improve the audio quality of its music production. Which upgrade is appropriate?
o: Integrated GPU → graphics card with 4 GB RAM
Integrated sound card → external sound card
mc.e: Audio quality depends on the sound card, which converts between analog sound and digital data.
mc.ez: 音质取决于声效卡（sound card）。

mc.q: Which is an advantage of a quad-core processor over a dual-core processor?
o: It usually has a higher clock speed.
It allows the monitor to display higher resolution.
mc.e: More cores means more processes can run at the same time.
mc.ez: 核心越多，可同时运行的程序越多，多工较好。

mc.q: Which component converts high-voltage AC to low-voltage DC for a computer?
mc.e: The power supply unit does the conversion.
mc.ez: PSU 轉換 AC 為 DC。

mc.q: In which unit is the power of a PSU measured?
mc.e: PSU power is in watts.

mc.q: Which components usually have the highest energy consumption in a system unit?
mc.e: Textbook tip: CPU and GPU.
mc.ez: CPU 和 GPU 最耗電。

mc.q: Which slot is mainly used to connect a network interface card (NIC)?
mc.e: PCIe connects graphics, sound and network cards.

mc.q:
A new SSD is to be connected to a motherboard. Which slots/ports could be used?
(1) SATA
(2) M.2
(3) HDMI
mc.e: HDMI is for display units.

mc.q: Which is a component of a graphics card but not of an iGPU?
mc.e: An iGPU has no RAM of its own.

mc.q: What is the function of the digital-to-analog converter on a graphics card?
o: Converts processing results into analog signals for display units
mc.e: It sends analog signals to monitors/projectors.
mc.ez: 轉成模擬訊號給顯示器。

mc.q:
An office computer is used only for word processing. Why is an iGPU suitable?
(1) Lower cost
(2) Lower energy consumption
(3) Higher graphics processing power
mc.e: iGPU has lower graphics power than a graphics card.

mc.q: Why are GPUs used as the core for training artificial intelligence?
o: They store more data than RAM.
They are good at doing a lot of simple computing at the same time.
They have more cache than CPUs.
They handle complex single tasks better than CPUs.
mc.e: AI analyses large amounts of data in parallel.
mc.ez: GPU 擅長同時大量簡單運算。

mc.q: The bus width of a computer is usually the same as
o: the word length of the CPU
mc.e: Textbook definition.

mc.q: Which bus is two-way?
mc.e: Only the data bus is bidirectional.
mc.ez: 只有 data bus 雙向。

mc.q: Which bus ensures the correct timing of data transfer?
mc.e: Control signals manage timing.
mc.ez: control bus 確保時間正確。

mc.q: A USB plug has a black tongue. Which standard is it?
mc.e: White 1.0, black 2.0, blue 3.0.

mc.q: 'Users can plug in or remove a USB device while the computer is still operating.' This feature is called
mc.e: USB supports hot swapping.

mc.q: Which operation is performed by the ALU?
o: Comparing whether two values are equal
Controlling data flow to output devices
Decoding the instruction in the CIR
Sending the address in the PC to the MAR
mc.e: Comparison is a logical operation of the ALU.
mc.ez: 比較是 ALU 的邏輯運算。

mc.q: Which is a logical operation?
mc.e: NOT is negation, a logical operation.

mc.q: Where is the result of an ALU arithmetic operation stored?
mc.e: The accumulator stores ALU results.

mc.q: The MDR is connected to main memory through the
mc.e: MAR uses the address bus; MDR uses the data bus.

mc.q: In the machine cycle, what happens immediately after the address in the PC is copied to the MAR?
o: The result is stored in the accumulator.
The PC is updated with the address of the instruction after next.
The MDR is copied to the CIR.
The instruction is decoded by the CU.
mc.e: Step 2 updates the PC.

mc.q: In which step of the seven-step machine cycle is the instruction copied from the MDR to the CIR?
mc.e: Step 5.

items.tz: 计算机系统：硬件与软件
k: A computer system consists of hardware and software. Hardware is the physical parts of the computer. Software is the data or instructions designed to help the computer accomplish specific tasks.

items.tz: 系统软件与应用软件比较
k: System software controls the hardware operation, manages system resources and provides a platform for application software. Application software allows users to perform specific tasks and runs on a platform provided by system software.

items.t: Relationship among users, software and hardware
items.tz: 用户、软件与硬件的关系
k: The user uses application software; application software runs on a platform provided by system software; system software controls the hardware.
An operating system controls the hardware operation and interacts with driver programs and application software.
Memory management allocates the memory of RAM for processing. Partitioning divides the secondary storage into more than one part so that different parts can be managed individually.

items.t: OS functions: user interface, user management, multitasking
items.tz: OS 功能：用户界面、用户管理、多任务
k: Multitasking means running more than one task at the same time. User management allows users to create user accounts and provides security.

items.tz: 单用户与多用户操作系统
k: A single-user OS allows only one user to access the operating system at the same time. A multi-user OS allows more than one user to access it at the same time and arranges system resources, like CPU time and storage space, for different users.

items.tz: 桌面、移动与网络操作系统
k: A mobile OS has more hardware optimisations, such as disabling applications from running in the background and screen timeout, for prolonging the battery life.

items.tz: 图形用户界面与命令行界面
k: A GUI is more intuitive and easy to use for new users. A CLI requires fewer system resources, such as memory, and usually runs faster than GUI due to the lack of graphics; it offers high flexibility and efficiency for experienced users.

items.t: Using the CLI: cd, copy and the * wildcard
items.tz: CLI 实操：cd、copy 与通配符 *
k: cd [path] means changing directory. copy [source file] [target file] copies the content of the source file to the target file. * is a wildcard.
Linux supports CLI and may support GUI. Windows Server, as a network OS, is a multi-user OS.
Utility programs are programs that maintain a computer system and improve its efficiency.

items.tz: 文件管理器与系统监察软件
k: A system monitor monitors the running processes and shows system resource usage, like CPU usage, memory usage and network traffic.

items.tz: 病毒侦测程序与防火墙软件
k: A virus checker needs to be updated constantly so that it has the latest information to judge whether a file or program is a virus or not. Firewall software monitors network traffic and protects computers against viruses from the network.

Data can be transmitted easily with smaller file size and a smaller number of files. The folder structure is maintained and can be restored once decompressed. Compressed files can be password protected.

items.t: Defragmentation software, backup software and uninstaller
items.tz: 磁盘碎片整理、备份软件与卸载程序
k: Defragmentation software redistributes the location of files in storage to improve the data access rate and storage efficiency. Backup software creates a backup of files and system settings so that the system can be restored to the previous state.

Fragmentation occurs when many files are created, edited and deleted when the file system is used for a long time. Files are stored as separate fragments, and such separation reduces the efficiency of data access.
Defragmentation reorganises the data in storage to achieve a higher data access rate and more efficient usage.
Driver programs are used to control peripheral devices by translating requests into machine level commands. Each driver program is designed for a specific OS to control a specific peripheral device.
Application software allows users to perform specific tasks and runs on a platform provided by system software.

items.tz: 生产力软件与办公套件
k: Productivity software is used to improve the productivity of working. It is used to produce, analyse or present information.
Communication software is used to exchange information between users via a network for communication purposes.
Media development software is used to create or edit multimedia files.
Educational software is used to acquire knowledge, enhance learning efficiency or assist educational workers in teaching students.
Modes of operation can be categorised by when to process (batch / real-time) and how to process (parallel / distributed).

A batch processing system collects data without immediately processing it. Instead, data is processed in a batch at regular intervals. It makes good use of idling system resources as the processes can be scheduled overnight.

A real-time processing system processes data as soon as the data is received. It allows users to get immediate responses that are up-to-date. However, it requires large computing power and main memory to keep its response time short.

A parallel processing system usually consists of multiple processors and memory can be shared among these processors. It may divide a task into multiple portions and assign a portion for each processor so that the task can be accomplished in a shorter time.

A distributed processing system consists of a high-speed network and multiple computers. A program or a computer is used to manage the interaction between these computers. It has high scalability as the number of computers can be increased or decreased according to our needs.

items.tz: 并行处理与分布式处理比较
k: In parallel processing, memory can be shared among processors; in distributed processing, memory is never shared and network connectivity is a must.

Virtualisation divides the computer hardware into multiple virtual portions with the help of utility programs. It increases the flexibility of computers and saves the cost of buying actual hardware devices.

mc.q: Why should a software suite be used in an IT project?
st: (1) Data used in the project can be shared within the software suite effectively.
(2) Data files generated by the software suite are smaller.
(3) The project will be in a web-based format.
mc.e: Programs in a suite share data and a common interface easily; file size and web format are not guaranteed.

mc.q: Tom currently uses a software package on a desktop computer. He tries to install this software on his tablet computer but fails. Why?
st: (1) The tablet computer uses a different operating system.
(2) The tablet computer uses a virtual keyboard.
(3) The tablet computer uses a solid-state drive.
mc.e: Software is built for a particular OS/platform; keyboard and drive type do not stop installation.

mc.q: Peter upgrades his desktop computer with a touch screen. Why?
o: This is a good ergonomic practice.
Many operating systems support touch screens.
A touch screen can be installed easily.
A touch screen allows for easier hand eye coordination than a keyboard.
mc.e: Touching what you see is more direct than typing, so hand-eye coordination is easier.

mc.q: A car is equipped with a global positioning system (GPS) such that the driver can get the location and time information when driving. Which of the following best describes the mode of operation of the system?
mc.e: Location must update instantly while driving: real-time processing.

mc.q: Which of the following classifications is correct?
o: Computer hardware: Modem, System software: PDF writer
Computer hardware: Touch screen, System software: RAM
Computer hardware: Word processor, System software: Spreadsheet
Computer hardware: ROM, System software: Utility program
mc.e: ROM is hardware; utility programs are system software.

mc.q: Which of the following functions does an operating system usually have?
mc.e: An OS provides the user interface and manages memory; the others are application software jobs.

mc.q:
A company invents a smart thermostat to control the temperature of a house through the Internet. Customers can install the smart thermostat in their house and adjust the heating/cooling functions of the air conditioner from a smart phone.

Which of the following best describe the application of the smart thermostat?
mc.e: Control is spread between phone, Internet and thermostat (distributed) and responds immediately (real-time).

mc.q: A booking system consists of several booking counters in different locations in a city. Customers can buy tickets for theatres through one of the booking counters. Which of the following best describes the booking system?
mc.e: Ticket sales must update seat availability immediately to avoid double booking: real-time.

mc.q: Which of the following functions will an operating system usually provide?
mc.e: Process control, memory allocation and network monitoring/logging are all OS functions.

mc.q: Which of the following items is/are system software?
mc.e: The OS and drivers are system software; spreadsheets are application software.

mc.q: What information is usually provided by the system monitoring software in an operating system?
mc.e: System monitors (e.g. Task Manager) show processes, memory and network use.

mc.q: Bank customers can withdraw cash from their accounts through Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Which of the following systems best describe(s) this operation?
mc.e: The user interacts with the ATM and the balance updates immediately.

mc.q: Which of the following are the basic functions of an operating system?
mc.e: Memory and I/O management are OS functions; email is handled by application software.

mc.q: Which of the following can help reduce the time needed to access files in a hard disk drive?
mc.e: Defragmentation puts each file's pieces next to each other, so the head moves less.

mc.q: Which of the following systems depends on network connectivity?
mc.e: Distributed processing spreads work over networked computers.

mc.q: Which of the following are the major networking functions of a typical computer operating system?
st: (2) Controlling the network bandwidth of a connection between two computers
(3) Providing some measure of network security to protect the computers from unauthorised access
mc.e: The OS supports communication and basic network security; it does not control link bandwidth.

mc.q: Which of the following descriptions of a driver program is correct?
o: Enables the operating system to manage files.
Enables the operating system to control a scanner.
Monitors the status of virus checking.
mc.e: A driver lets the OS communicate with a hardware device.

mc.q: Which of the following requires a driver program?
mc.e: A device driver lets the OS talk to a hardware device such as a new printer.

mc.q: David builds a computer system at home that his friends can log in to and on which they can play an online football game together. Which of the following modes of processing is/are involved?
mc.e: Players interact online and the game responds immediately (real-time). No batch jobs.

mc.q: John has a desktop computer installed with a 500GB SSD and a 2TB hard disk drive. Why is an operating system installed in the SSD instead of the hard disk drive?
o: The operating system is not open source software.
The files of the operating system are frequently used.
The storage size required for the operating system is smaller than 500 GB.
Data files need to be stored in the hard disk.
mc.e: OS files are accessed all the time, so put them on the faster SSD.

mc.q: When developing a management information system, which of the following should be the first item to be considered?
mc.e: You first need to know what the system is for. Technology, people and cost follow from that.

mc.q: Why do we need to regularly update software?
mc.e: Updates fix bugs, add functions and improve performance: all three.

mc.q: A company develops a computer system for autopilot driving, so that a vehicle can collect and use image data from the environment and drive on the road safely. It is a real-time processing system because ________.
o: the computers involved should have a high processing power
there should be no time delay between data input and the data processing
a large amount of data should be collected over a period of time
it provides resources and services to multiple users at a time
mc.e: Real-time means input is processed immediately. C describes batch processing and D describes time-sharing.

mc.q: There are one hundred 300GB surveillance video files. Without any file reorganisation and compression, how many 2TB hard disks are needed to store all the video files?
mc.e: Files cannot be split. A 2TB (2048GB) disk holds 6 files (1800GB). 100 ÷ 6 = 16.7, so 17 disks.

mc.q: Mary only has a computer without any network connections. Which of the following systems can she carry out?
mc.e: Distributed processing needs a network. Real-time and batch processing can run on one computer.

mc.q: Which of the following are functions of an operating system?
mc.e: The OS allocates resources and schedules jobs. Permanent storage is done by storage devices.

mc.q: Which of the following programs is used to improve the access time of files in a hard disk?
mc.e: Defragmentation puts file pieces together so the head moves less.

mc.q: In a commercial building, the security system will activate the alarm if one of the main doors is opened between 12 a.m. and 6 a.m. What kind of system is this?
mc.e: It must respond immediately to an event: real-time.

mc.q: The following diagram shows: User → (controls) → Application programs → (run on) → X. What is X?
mc.e: Application software runs on a platform provided by system software.
mc.ez: 应用程序运行于系统软件提供的平台。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch3 Chapter Exercise MC1 (p.115)

mc.q: Which of the following statements about the user interface of an OS is correct?
o: OS with a CLI is usually used to run media development software.
OS with a CLI does not require pointing devices.
OS with a GUI usually requires fewer system resources.
OS with a GUI cannot be controlled with commands.
mc.e: A CLI uses the keyboard only, no pointing devices.
mc.src: Textbook B Ch3 Chapter Exercise MC2 (p.115)

mc.q: Which of the following is NOT a primary function of an operating system?
o: Check for viruses in the system
mc.e: Virus checking is done by a utility program (virus checker).
mc.ez: 查毒是实用程序的功能。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch3 Chapter Exercise MC3 (p.115)

mc.q: Which of the following are examples of utility programs? (1) System monitor (2) Virus checker (3) Data compressor (4) Word processor
mc.e: A word processor is productivity (application) software.
mc.ez: 文字处理器是应用软件。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch3 Chapter Exercise MC4 (p.115)

mc.q: Which statement about defragmentation software is correct?
o: It is usually used in a solid-state drive.
It increases the data access rate by redistributing the location of files physically.
It deletes useless data from the storage.
mc.e: It redistributes file locations to improve access rate; it is a utility, not needed for SSDs, and deletes nothing.
mc.ez: 重新分布文件位置提高读取速度。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch3 Chapter Exercise MC5 (p.115)

mc.q: Which statement about driver programs is correct?
o: Driver programs may be installed together with the operating system.
Basic peripheral devices such as keyboards and mice do not require driver programs.
Driver programs operate independently from the operating system.
Driver programs never support hot swapping.
mc.e: Some drivers come with the OS.
mc.ez: 有些驱动随 OS 附带。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch3 Chapter Exercise MC6 (p.115)

mc.q: Tommy is an office assistant in an animation studio. Which software will he need? (1) Operating system (2) Productivity software (3) Communication software
mc.e: He needs an OS, office software and email/messaging.
mc.src: Textbook B Ch3 Chapter Exercise MC7 (p.115)

mc.q: Tom installs an app that displays his current location in real time and shows current traffic. Which best describes its mode of operation?
mc.e: Data is processed as soon as received to give up-to-date responses.
mc.src: Textbook B Ch3 Chapter Exercise MC8 (p.116)

mc.q: An online shopping platform handles multiple transactions at the same time, allocating different transactions to different processors. Which best describes the mode of operation?
mc.e: Multiple processors performing tasks concurrently = parallel processing.
mc.ez: 多处理器同时处理 = 并行。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch3 Chapter Exercise MC9 (p.116)

mc.q: Ben's current OS does not support a software he wants. Which method allows him to install it on his computer?
o: Add more memory to the computer.
Create a virtual machine in his current computer.
mc.e: A VM can run a different OS that supports the software.
mc.ez: 虚拟机可运行其他 OS。
mc.src: Textbook B Ch3 Chapter Exercise MC10 (p.116)

mc.q: Which of the following is not necessarily a feature of a computer OS? (1) Peripheral device management (2) Graphical user interface (3) Memory management (4) Database management
mc.e: Some OS use CLI instead of GUI; database management belongs to a DBMS.
mc.ez: GUI 不一定有；数据库管理属 DBMS。

mc.q: Which statement about operating systems is true? (1) Linux does not support GUI. (2) Windows Server, as a network OS, is a multi-user OS. (3) iOS is open source.
mc.e: Some Linux distributions have GUI; iOS is owned by Apple.

mc.q: Which statements about modes of operation are correct? (1) Distributed processing requires network connectivity. (2) Batch processing does not process data once the data is received. (3) Parallel processing can divide a task into subtasks and assign them to different computers.
mc.e: Parallel processing uses processors, not computers.
mc.ez: 并行用处理器而非电脑。

mc.q: Owen wants to create a virtual machine to play mobile games on his computer. Excluding the games, what does he need? (1) Application software (2) Operating system (3) Utility program
mc.e: A utility program creates the VM; a mobile OS runs on it.

mc.q:
Which of the following is/are NOT required for conducting a conference call?
(1) Webcam
(2) Defragmentation software
(3) Webcam driver program
mc.e: A webcam and its driver program are needed for video; defragmentation software only rearranges files on a hard disk.
mc.ez: 视像会议需要 webcam 及其 driver；磁碟重组软件与会议无关。

mc.q:
Tommy wants to edit a video. Which of the following is/are necessary?
(1) Media development software
(2) Drawing tablet
(3) Driver program for the drawing tablet
mc.e: Video editing needs media development (video editing) software; a drawing tablet is optional.
mc.ez: 剪片只需媒体开发软件（video editing software）；绘图板并非必需。

mc.q:
David uses his computer for simple tasks such as word processing. Which is required?
(1) Driver program for the keyboard
(2) Productivity software
(3) Data compressor
mc.e: He needs the keyboard driver and a word processor (productivity software); a data compressor is optional.
mc.ez: 需要键盘 driver 和文书处理软件；压缩程式非必需。

mc.q: Andy wants to send a file to friends by email but it is too big. Which method can he use?
o: Increase the secondary storage space of the system unit.
Use file sharing software to share the file.
Use defragmentation software to reduce the file size.
mc.e: File sharing software transfers large files over the internet. Defragmentation does not shrink files.
mc.ez: 用档案分享软件传送大档；磁碟重组不会缩小档案。

mc.q: Which of the following is an example of batch processing?
o: Using all the computers of the office to process a complicated task
Performing backup on a messaging application every midnight
Deleting all the data from a storage device at once
Updating certain information in real time
mc.e: Scheduled backup at regular intervals is a textbook example of batch processing. Option A is distributed processing.
mc.ez: 每晚定时备份是 batch processing；A 是 distributed processing。

mc.q:
Which of the following can be shared out in virtualisation?
(1) Main memory
(2) Driver programs
(3) Secondary storage
mc.e: Virtualisation assigns portions of hardware resources (computing power, main memory, secondary storage) to a virtual machine.
mc.ez: 虚拟化分配的是硬件资源：运算能力、主记忆体、辅助储存。

mc.q: Software is best defined as
o: any device connected to a computer
the data or instructions designed to help the computer accomplish specific tasks
the physical parts of a computer
mc.e: Textbook definition of software.

mc.q: Which of the following is application software?
mc.e: Photoshop lets users perform a specific task.

mc.q: System software is usually written in
mc.e: Per Table 3.1.
mc.ez: 系统软件通常用低级语言。

mc.q: Which statement about system and application software is correct?
o: System software runs on a platform provided by application software.
Application software controls the hardware operation directly.
Application software is usually written in low-level languages.
System software manages system resources and provides a platform for application software.
mc.e: Table 3.1 dependence row.

mc.q: In the user–software–hardware relationship, system software ____ the hardware.
mc.e: System software controls hardware.

mc.q: Which OS function allocates the memory of RAM for processing?
mc.e: Memory management allocates RAM.

mc.q: Erasing all data in secondary storage and configuring it for initial use is called
mc.e: Formatting.

mc.q: Dividing a hard disk into C: and D: so each part can be managed individually is
mc.e: Partitioning is part of disk management.

mc.q: An administrator changes a student's password and access rights. Which OS function is this?
mc.e: User management.

mc.q: Which OS function controls input and output of peripheral devices via driver programs?
mc.e: Peripheral device management.

mc.q: A home computer has 3 user accounts, but only one person can use it at a time. Its OS is a
mc.e: Single-user OS may have more than one account.
mc.ez: 单用户 OS 可有多账户。

mc.q: Which allocates CPU time and storage space to different users accessing it simultaneously?
mc.e: Multi-user OS arranges resources for users.

mc.q: Disabling apps from running in the background and screen timeout are features mainly of
mc.e: Mobile OS optimises hardware to prolong battery life.
mc.ez: 移动 OS 延长电池寿命。

mc.q: Which type of OS mainly provides file sharing, web hosting and database management services?
mc.e: Network OS for servers.

mc.q: A desktop OS is more comprehensive mainly because of
mc.e: Table 3.4.

mc.q: Which is an advantage of a CLI over a GUI?
o: Requires fewer system resources and usually runs faster
mc.e: No graphics → fewer resources.

mc.q: Which is an advantage of a GUI over a CLI?
o: More intuitive and easy to use for new users
mc.e: GUI is intuitive.

mc.q: In Windows Command Prompt, what does cd C:\data do?
o: Changes the current directory to C:\data
mc.e: cd = change directory.

mc.q: In copy *.txt combine.txt, the symbol * is
o: a wildcard matching any file name
mc.e: * is a wildcard.

mc.q: Which OS is open source and based on Linux?
mc.e: Table 3.6.

k: A computer network is an interconnection of computers and peripheral devices. Its purpose is to exchange information and share hardware and software resources.
A LAN covers a small geographical area such as a school. A WAN consists of many LANs and covers a large geographical area; the Internet is the largest WAN.

items.t: Misconception: LAN vs WAN is not only about distance
items.tz: 误解：LAN/WAN 只看覆盖范围
k: The difference between a LAN and a WAN depends on how the devices are connected. Once computers are connected through an ISP, they form a WAN even in a small coverage area.
In a client-server network, a centralised administrative system (server) is present. All resources are stored in the server and shared among the clients. Clients request services from the server.

items.t: Common types of servers and the domain controller
items.tz: 常见服务器类型与 domain controller
k: A domain controller stores user account information, authenticates users and authorises user access rights, giving centralised user management.
In a peer-to-peer network, devices share resources without a centralised administrative system; devices connect and make requests directly to one another.

items.t: P2P file sharing tools and the "P2P payment" trap
items.tz: P2P 文件分享工具与「P2P 付款」陷阱
k: P2P payment means person-to-person payment; it uses a client-server network because every transaction is recorded on the bank's centralised server.

items.tz: 客户端-服务器与对等网络比较
k: always give the advantage and the reason, e.g. "Client-server is more secure because user accounts and access rights are managed centrally by the administrator."
Network services include internal communications, conferencing and resource sharing (file, hardware, software and Internet access sharing).
The quality of conferencing depends on the data transmission rate (bandwidth). Video signals are compressed before transmission to reduce the bandwidth required.
Storing data on a central server maintains consistency of data, facilitates backup and allows users to work on the same folder at the same time.
A printer shared through computer A can only be used when computer A is switched on, and it uses A's resources. A network printer connects directly to the network and does not depend on any computer.

items.t: Software sharing and Internet access sharing
k: Software sharing saves software licensing cost. Internet access sharing reduces the cost of service and allows the traffic to be monitored and controlled.

items.tz: 判断 client-server 或 P2P 服务
k: "This is client-server because the teacher's computer acts as a print/file server that provides the service to the other computers."

items.t: Network Interface Card (NIC) and MAC address
k: A NIC allows a device to communicate over a network. Each NIC has a unique 48-bit MAC address, assigned by the manufacturer, used to identify the device in a network.
A switch connects devices to form a LAN and directs incoming data to the destination device based on its MAC address. Data buffering in a switch prevents data collision.

items.tz: 接入点与 Wi-Fi 漫游
k: An AP connects to a wired LAN and provides wireless connection to devices to form a WLAN. For roaming, all APs should have the same SSID so devices switch between APs automatically and seamlessly.
A router connects LANs with each other or connects a LAN with a WAN. It forwards incoming data to the destination based on the IP address and determines the next network node to send the packet to.
A switch is a multiport device that manages the flow of data in a LAN using MAC addresses. A router forwards data packets between two networks using IP addresses.

items.tz: 数据机、ADSL/SDSL 与光纤数据机
k: A modem converts between the analog signals from the Internet and the digital signals from computers (modulation and demodulation).

items.tz: 拨号调制解调器与窄带
k: A dial-up modem transmits data through a telephone line at up to 56 kbps (narrowband), and the line cannot be used for phone calls at the same time.

items.t: Twisted pair cables: UTP and STP
k: Twisting the copper wires reduces electromagnetic interference and crosstalk. STP is less affected by EMI than UTP but has a higher cost.
Fibre optic cable transmits data as light by total internal reflection. It has the fastest speed, is not affected by EMI and has less distance restriction, but it is expensive and hard to install.

items.tz: HomePlug（电力线网络）与 Mesh Wi-Fi
k: A mesh Wi-Fi system interconnects multiple wireless routers as nodes so that data goes through the best available path, reducing network congestion.

Satellite can build a network connection in remote areas where wired connection is not accessible, but it is very expensive and its stability is affected by bad weather and sunspot activity. Microwave requires a straight line of sight between terminals.
A GPS receiver calculates its location from the time differences of signals from at least four satellites (multilateration).
5 GHz Wi-Fi has a higher speed and less interference but a shorter range than 2.4 GHz. 2.4 GHz is interfered by microwave ovens and Bluetooth devices.
802.11ac has a higher maximum data rate (1 Gbps) than 802.11g (54 Mbps), and uses the 5 GHz band instead of 2.4 GHz.
Bluetooth is used for short-distance wireless data transmission between mobile devices. It has low power consumption and high compatibility, but a shorter range and lower data rate than Wi-Fi.
NFC is an extension of RFID that supports bi-directional communication; compared with Bluetooth it has lower power consumption and a faster connection speed.

Throughput is the actual amount of data transferred successfully in a given time; it is lower than bandwidth due to network congestion, bottlenecks and poor signals. 5G provides high throughput, low latency and high capacity.

items.tz: 有线网络 vs 无线网络
k: A wired network has a higher data transfer rate and better security; a wireless network needs no cabling and allows mobility, but is slower and less stable.

items.tz: 互联网服务供应商与宽频
k: An ISP is a company that provides services for accessing the Internet. Broadband is a wired connection with high bandwidth and moderate cost, but the bandwidth is shared with other users.
FTTH uses fibre optic cable all the way to the home, so it is faster than FTTC and ADSL, which use copper telephone cable for part or all of the path.

A leased line is a private network connecting to the ISP directly over a dedicated channel which does not share bandwidth with other users. It has the highest bandwidth, security and stability but the highest cost.

items.t: Leased line vs broadband at the same speed
items.tz: 相同速度下的专线 vs 宽带
k: A leased line provides a guaranteed bandwidth over a dedicated channel that does not share infrastructure, so it is more reliable, stable and secure, though more expensive.

items.tz: 流动数据与 Wi-Fi 热点
k: Mobile data provides wireless Internet access through the cellular network with high availability. A public Wi-Fi hotspot has low cost but the lowest security and low availability.
Compared with 4G, 5G has a higher data transfer rate, larger capacity and lower latency, and can connect many devices at the same time, which supports IoT.
name the method and link it to the need, e.g. "A leased line should be used because it has the highest security and does not share bandwidth with other users."

mc.q:
Henry lives in Hong Kong. He likes bags made in Europe so he buys a bag through the online shopping web site of a shop in France.
There are different kinds of online shopping web sites. What features do they usually have?
mc.e: Shops need payment (EFT) and a DBMS for products/orders; p2p and mainframes are not typical.

mc.q: Why should network interface cards (NICs) be used in a computer network?
st: (1) The network needs to support data transfer at 10GB per second.
(2) NICs connect computers to the network.
(3) NICs convert analog signals into digital signals and vice versa.
mc.e: A NIC is the hardware that connects a computer to the network; A/D conversion is a modem's job.

mc.q: A search engine can automatically return the search results related to the country in which the computer is located. Which of the following discloses this location information?
mc.e: The IP address given by the ISP shows which country/region the user is in.

mc.q: Which of the following is a function of a switch?
st: (1) Connects computers to form a LAN.
(2) Controls the network traffic in a network.
(4) Connects a LAN to the Internet.
mc.e: A switch links devices in one LAN and forwards frames only to the right port; joining networks is a router's job.

mc.q: Mary has a wireless network with Internet access at home. She finds that the file transfer rate between a notebook computer and a desktop computer through the network is very low. What is the possible reason for this?
o: The communication protocols used by the two computers are different.
There is a thick wall between the computers and the wireless router.
mc.e: Walls weaken Wi-Fi signals and lower the transfer rate inside the LAN.

mc.q: A proxy server in a school network can ______.
st: (1) increase the bandwidth of the Internet connection
mc.e: Proxies filter and cache pages; they can't raise the line's bandwidth.

mc.q:
Peter can use the following two methods to download files. He chooses Method 1. Why?
Method 1: Direct download through HTTP
Method 2: Download using Peer-to-Peer (P2P) file sharing technology
o: The data transfer rate is higher.
It is illegal to use Method 2.
mc.e: HTTP download just needs a browser; P2P needs a special client.

mc.q: A cloud computing company not only provides cloud storage but also allows customers to make their files available offline. What is the major benefit of this arrangement?
o: Customers can remove the files from the cloud storage easily.
Customers can increase the bandwidth of the network connection.
Customers can access the files through their smart phones.
Customers can edit the files without Internet connection.
mc.e: Offline copies can be used and edited without an Internet connection.

mc.q: The Internet of Things (IoT) refers to the networks formed by devices which can collect and exchange data. The networks are usually connected to the Internet. Which of the following items should the devices usually have?
o: a CPU with a high processing power
mc.e: To communicate on the Internet, each device needs an IP address.

mc.q: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government has set up GovWiFi to provide free wireless Internet access and citizens can opt to use the unencrypted connection or the encrypted connection. Which of the following statements is correct?
o: Citizens can only enjoy Internet access at designated spots.
Citizens cannot access online banking web sites through the unencrypted connection.
Citizens' devices can be protected from computer viruses through the encrypted connection.
Citizens will have priority to book the Government leisure facilities through GovWiFi.
mc.e: Wi-Fi hotspots only work at designated spots; encryption does not stop viruses.

mc.q: Mr Li considers some communication links for building a network in a company and compares their effective data transfer rates. Which of the following comparisons is correct?
mc.e: Satellite is slowest, Cat 6 is up to 1–10 Gbps, fibre is fastest.

mc.q: Which of the following is the major function of a switch in a school computer network?
mc.e: A switch forwards data between the computers in a LAN.

mc.q: Which of the following is/are the advantage(s) of setting up a wireless network to replace a wired network?
mc.e: Wireless gives mobility but is usually slower and less secure.

mc.q: A router should be used to connect ________.
o: a printer and a local area network
mc.e: A router forwards packets between different networks.

mc.q: Which of the following are the advantages of using a LAN over a WAN?
mc.e: LANs are faster and cheaper but cover a smaller area.

mc.q: What is/are the advantage(s) of using a network connection on a leased line instead of by broadband?
mc.e: A leased line is dedicated: reliable with guaranteed bandwidth, but costly.

mc.q: Which of the following can improve the quality of video conferencing?
st: (1) A camera with a higher resolution
mc.e: Better cameras and more bandwidth improve live video; storage does not.

mc.q: What is the main function of a network interface card?
o: To find a route for sending data packets
To make a computer communicate over a network
To enhance the security level of a communication link
mc.e: A NIC connects the computer to the network.

mc.q: Which of the following is commonly used for connecting two LANs?
mc.e: Routers forward packets between different networks.

mc.q: Mary can use her mobile phone in her office to control the appliances connecting to a Wi-Fi network at home. Which of the following are involved?
mc.e: Office → Internet → home LAN → Wi-Fi access point → appliance. Only 35% got all three.

mc.q: Mr Li rents online file storage services for the staff working in his office, instead of setting up file servers. Why?
st: The bandwidth of the Internet connection for the office is not sufficient.
Additional technical staff is not needed in the office.
It gives flexibility when increasing the storage size.
mc.e: Cloud storage needs no in-house IT staff and scales easily. Low bandwidth would be a reason AGAINST cloud.

mc.q: In a school playground, although a wired network has been installed, the school installs an Access Point connecting to the network. Why?
st: Students can use tablet computers for lessons.
The network can be used 24 hours a day.
The data transfer rate for the network connections is higher.
mc.e: An AP lets wireless devices join. Wired is usually faster, and both work 24 hours.

mc.q: One day, Mary finds that she cannot access the Internet through her computer at home. Which of the following is a possible cause?
o: The size of ROM is small.
The data transfer rate of the hard disk is low.
The graphics card is out of order.
The network interface card is out of order.
mc.e: The network interface card connects the computer to the network. The others do not stop Internet access.

mc.q: Fibre optics is used in a computer network because ________.
st: it supports both wired and wireless connections
its data transfer rate is very high
it supports a connection with a long distance
mc.e: Fibre is fast and works over long distances. It is a wired medium only.

mc.q: Internet Protocol (IP) is used in a computer network because ________.
o: data can be transmitted under the same communication rules
computers in the network are installed with the same operating system
the maximum data transfer rates between computers are the same
the network is a LAN instead of a WAN
mc.e: A protocol is a set of shared communication rules, so different machines can talk.

mc.q: Amy uses a computer to watch streaming videos. Which of the following should she consider?
mc.e: Streaming needs enough bandwidth. The video is not saved, so disk size does not matter.

mc.q: Which of following about wired networks and wireless networks is correct?
o: Wired network: A more stable connection, Wireless network: Flexible network access
Wired network: Higher network security, Wireless network: A more stable connection
Wired network: Flexible network access, Wireless network: Higher network security
Wired network: Flexible network access, Wireless network: A more stable connection
mc.e: Wired is more stable; wireless gives flexible access.

mc.q: A company establishes a WAN instead of a LAN mainly because of the _____________ .
mc.e: A WAN covers a larger geographical area.

mc.q: A company subscribes for a 10M leased line instead of a 10M broadband connection because _________ .
o: the maximum data transfer rate is higher
it is for commercial use only
mc.e: A leased line is a dedicated private line, so it is more secure (and stable); same 10M speed, more expensive.

mc.q: Tom wants to upgrade the bandwidth of a school network from 100 Mbps to 10 Gbps. Which of the following upgrade plans do you suggest?
o: Current: Internal network interface card, Suggested upgrade: USB network interface card
Current: wired connection, Suggested upgrade: wireless connection
Current: CAT 5 cable, Suggested upgrade: Optical fibre
mc.e: CAT 5 tops out around 100 Mbps; optical fibre supports 10 Gbps.

mc.q: Which of the following is not an online public service provided by ESDlife（生活易）?
o: Booking an appointment to give a marriage notice
mc.e: Per the official key (B): booking a (private) dentist appointment was not one of ESDlife's government e-services; the others were.

mc.q: Downloading files with BitTorrent is an example of
mc.e: BitTorrent is P2P.

mc.q: Which can improve video quality in conferencing? (1) higher data transfer rate network (2) higher resolution camera
mc.e: Both help (camera needs bandwidth too).
mc.src: Textbook C1 Ch1 Checkpoint (DSE 2020 1A Q24), adapted

mc.q: A printer is connected by USB to computer A and shared. Which is a disadvantage?
o: Printer unusable when A is off
Printer gets its own MAC address
mc.e: Depends on A.
mc.src: Textbook C1 Ch1 Checkpoint (DSE 2013 1B Q1a), adapted

mc.q: Which link requires line of sight?
mc.e: Microwave.
mc.src: Textbook C1 Ch1 Exercise MC, adapted

mc.q: The main purpose of a computer network is to
mc.e: Networks exist to exchange information and share hardware/software.
mc.ez: 网络目的是交换资讯和共享资源。

mc.q: Which is a DISADVANTAGE of networking computers?
o: Malware can spread to other computers
mc.e: Networks raise security risks.
mc.ez: 网络令恶意软件容易扩散。

mc.q: Which is NOT a peripheral device commonly shared on a network?
mc.e: Registers are inside the CPU.
mc.ez: 寄存器在 CPU 内，不能共享。

mc.q: A network covering one school campus is a
mc.e: Small area → LAN.

mc.q: Compared with a WAN, a LAN usually has
mc.e: LAN: small, cheap, fast.

mc.q: Which statement about LAN and WAN is correct?
o: Computers connected through an ISP can form a WAN even if close together
mc.e: Depends on how devices are connected.

mc.q: In a client-server network, the device that requests services is the
mc.e: Clients request; servers provide.

mc.q: Which server hosts web-based applications such as Google Docs?
mc.e: Application server.

mc.q: Which is an advantage of a client-server network?
o: Easier to back up and recover data
mc.e: Central storage simplifies backup.

mc.q: Which is a disadvantage of a client-server network?
o: Service stops when the server is down
mc.e: Single point of failure.

mc.q: Which is an advantage of a P2P network?
o: Lower cost as no server is needed
mc.e: No server cost.

mc.q: Which feature belongs to P2P networks?
o: Devices connect directly using dedicated software
Resources stored only on one server
mc.e: Direct device-to-device.

mc.q: A web server usually needs
o: large storage for web pages and multimedia
mc.e: Hosts pages and media.

mc.q: Which is NOT one of the common network services in the textbook?
mc.e: Defragmentation is not a network service.
mc.ez: 磁碟重组不是网络服务。

mc.q: Bandwidth is measured in
mc.e: bps.

mc.q: Companies send confidential messages through the Intranet mainly for
mc.e: Not over public Internet.

mc.q: Which access right lets a user open but not change files in a shared folder?
mc.e: Read only.

mc.q: SOHO stands for
mc.e: Small Office/Home Office.
mc.ez: 小型办公室/家居办公室。

mc.q: Which is NOT an advantage of storing data on a central server?
o: Works even when the network is down
Users can work on the same folder
mc.e: Needs the network.

mc.q: Installing software on a server and letting staff use it by remote logon mainly
o: removes the need for a network
mc.e: Fewer licences.

k: A protocol is a set of rules that specify the format and order of the data sent and received between devices. Standard protocols allow devices with different operating systems/hardware to communicate.

items.t: Protocols in everyday terms and the TCP 3-way handshake
items.tz: 协定的日常比喻与 TCP 三次握手
k: Protocols are sets of rules that specify the format and order of data exchanged, so devices with different operating systems can communicate.

TCP divides data into smaller packets, numbers them, and reassembles them at the destination. IP adds source and destination IP addresses and selects the path (an alternative path to avoid congestion). If a packet is corrupted, only that packet needs to be resent.

items.tz: 五层 TCP/IP 协定堆叠与封装
k: Transport layer divides data into packets and adds a transport header; Network layer adds a network header with IP addresses; Data Link layer maps the IP address to the MAC address; Physical layer transmits the data as bit streams. Decapsulation is the reverse process.

An IP address is a changeable numerical address used to identify a device in a network; it must be unique. The IP address identifies the location of the device in the network, while the MAC address identifies the device (NIC) itself.
An IPv4 address is a 32-bit numerical address formed by four 8-bit numbers separated by periods; each number ranges from 0 to 255.

items.t: IPv6 and why it was introduced
k: IPv4 addresses are being used up due to the growth of Internet devices, so IPv6 was introduced to provide more addresses. An IPv6 address is a 128-bit address formed by eight 16-bit hexadecimal numbers separated by colons.
Leading zeros in each group can be omitted. One sequence of consecutive zero groups can be replaced by a double colon (::), and :: can appear only once.

items.t: Valid or invalid IP address? IP vs MAC
items.tz: IP 地址是否有效？IP 与 MAC
k: Each number in an IPv4 address is 8 bits, so it must be from 0 to 255.
A domain name is a human-readable and meaningful form of an IP address. An FQDN consists of all domain levels in the DNS hierarchy, each delimited by a period.
gTLD indicates the type of organisation; ccTLD indicates the country or region. Domain names are registered through ICANN-accredited registrars.

items.t: How many domain names to register? Second-level domains
items.tz: 要注册多少个域名？二级域名
